title: Senior Manager / Manager - Transformation & Performance Excellence
description:
-   Translate approved organizational priorities into a structured process transformation portfolio, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes in alignment with business, customer, risk and regulatory requirements.
    
-   Drive cross-functional transformation initiatives from opportunity assessment and business case development through design, implementation, stabilization and post-implementation review.
    
-   Assess end-to-end processes, customer journeys, operating models and business capabilities to identify performance gaps, growth enablers and opportunities for simplification, scalability and service excellence.
    
-   Establish transformation charters, baselines, milestones, governance, dependencies and performance measures; monitor delivery progress, escalate barriers and ensure timely corrective actions.
    
-   Drive process innovation by evaluating, piloting and scaling solutions using workflow automation, RPA, analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), APIs and other emerging technologies in collaboration with relevant teams.
    
-   Measure transformation impact through productivity, quality, risk, customer experience and revenue-related indicators.
    
-   Build transformation capability and adoption by facilitating workshops, coaching process owners and champions, communicating change and capturing lessons learned.

title: Litigation Officer
description:
**Litigation Management**

-   Handle and coordinate all litigation matters involving the Company before the Supreme Court of Bangladesh, subordinate courts, tribunals, quasi-judicial authorities, and other judicial or regulatory forums.
-   Manage civil, criminal, commercial, labour, consumer, constitutional, regulatory, administrative, arbitration, and other legal proceedings involving the Company.
-   Liaise with external advocates, chambers, and legal consultants to ensure effective conduct of litigation.
-   Monitor the progress of ongoing cases and maintain comprehensive litigation records, hearing schedules, and case status reports.
-   Ensure timely filing of pleadings, affidavits, petitions, written statements, appeals, revisions, applications, and other legal documents.
-   Coordinate with internal departments to collect evidence, documents, witnesses, and information required for litigation.

 **Dispute Resolution**

-   Manage legal disputes arising from contracts, employment matters, commercial transactions, vendor relationships, customer claims, intellectual property matters, healthcare operations, regulatory issues, and other corporate activities.
-   Manage disputes or complaints arising from Directorate of National Consumer Rights Protection (DNCRP) and Land related disputes.
-   Assist in negotiation, mediation, settlement discussions, arbitration, and alternative dispute resolution proceedings.
-   Evaluate litigation risks and recommend appropriate legal strategies to minimize legal exposure.

**Legal Drafting & Documentation**

-   Draft, review, vet, and finalize plaints, written statements, petitions, affidavits, legal notices, replies, applications, agreements, undertakings, memoranda, powers of attorney, board resolutions, settlement agreements, and other legal documents.
-   Vet commercial agreements and legal documents to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protection of the Company's interests.
-   Prepare legal opinions and internal advisory notes on litigation and dispute-related matters.

**Legal Compliance & Advisory**

-   Advise management on litigation risks, legal developments, and dispute prevention strategies.
-   Ensure compliance with applicable laws, court directions, regulatory requirements, and legal procedures.
-   Coordinate with regulatory authorities, government offices, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders whenever required.

**Reporting & Record Management**

-   Maintain an updated litigation database and document management system.
-   Prepare periodic litigation status reports, legal risk assessments, and management updates.
-   Maintain confidentiality of all litigation-related information and legal documentation.

**Other Responsibilities**

-   Provide legal support to the Compliance & People Department on corporate legal matters whenever required.
-   Perform any other legal duties assigned by the management from time to time.

title: Assistant Manager – Industrial Engineering-IE (Woven Washing)
description:
**Job Context:** To improve productivity, optimize washing processes, reduce production costs, establish standard operating methods, and ensure efficient utilization of manpower, machines, chemicals, and utilities while maintaining buyer quality standards and on-time shipment. The role supports capacity planning, SMV development, line balancing, process improvement, and Lean Manufacturing implementation in the woven washing plant.

_**Responsibilities:**_

1.  **Industrial Engineering:** Conduct Time & Motion Studies for all washing processes, develop and maintain Standard Minute Values (SMV), prepare operation bulletins and process flow charts, establish standard manpower and machine requirements, optimize machine loading and production flow, and drive continuous process improvement to enhance operational efficiency.
    
2.  **Capacity Planning:** Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly capacity plans, calculate washing machine capacity and perform bottleneck analysis, ensure optimum utilization of washing machines, hydro extractors, dryers, ovens, laser machines, ozone machines, PP spray booths, and finishing sections, while monitoring actual performance against planned capacity.
    
3.  **Productivity Improvement:** Monitor machine efficiency, labor productivity, washing efficiency, DHU, rework, and idle time; identify productivity losses; implement Kaizen initiatives; reduce waiting time and process delays; and improve overall production throughput.
    
4.  **Cost Control:** Analyze chemical, water, steam, and electricity consumption, optimize production processes to reduce manufacturing costs, and support cost-saving initiatives while maintaining product quality and operational standards.
    
5.  **Method Improvement:** Conduct method studies, eliminate non-value-added activities, standardize washing procedures, and improve workflow and material handling to enhance overall operational efficiency.
    
6.  **KPI Management:** Monitor, analyze, and report key performance indicators including efficiency, capacity utilization, machine utilization, SMV achievement, productivity, cost per piece, chemical and water consumption, DHU, rework percentage, and overtime hours to support data-driven decision-making.
    
7.  **Lean Manufacturing:** Implement Lean Manufacturing tools including 5S, Kaizen, Visual Management, Root Cause Analysis, PDCA, and 5 Why methodology, while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the washing plant.
    
8.  **Data Analysis & Reporting:** Prepare and maintain daily efficiency reports, capacity reports, productivity reports, washing performance dashboards, cost analysis reports, monthly IE MIS, and improvement action plans to support management decision-making.
    
9.  **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Production, Washing Laboratory, Quality, Merchandising, Planning, Maintenance, Chemical Store, Finishing, and the Industrial Engineering team to ensure seamless production planning and execution.
    
10.  **Team Management:** Lead and mentor IE Officers and Executives, train supervisors on Industrial Engineering concepts and best practices, conduct productivity awareness programs, and evaluate team performance to build a high-performing IE function.

title: Accountant, IFRC Gratuity & Provident Fund (GPF)

company.name: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies.

description:
The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian organization, with a network of 191-member National Societies. The overall aim of the IFRC is “to inspire, encourage, facilitate, and promote at all times all forms of humanitarian activities by National Societies with a view to preventing and alleviating human suffering and thereby contributing to the maintenance and promotion of human dignity and peace in the world.”  The IFRC works to meet the needs and improve the lives of vulnerable people before, during and after disasters, health emergencies and other crises.  
  
In Bangladesh, the IFRC maintains a Provident and Gratuity Fund (GPF) for its national employees as a fringe benefit, in accordance with the labor laws of Bangladesh and the fund’s approved Trust Deed and By-laws. The GPF Trust is registered with the National Board of Revenue (NBR) and managed under the oversight of a Board of Trustees, chaired by a designated IFRC official.  
  
To ensure transparent, efficient, and compliant management of the Fund, the IFRC seeks to engage a qualified and experienced accounting/finance management  professional to provide end-to-end management support to the GPF Trust, covering finance, accounting, reporting, compliance, and member support functions.

**Duration of the contract:** 12 months, with possible extension

**Reporting to:** Treasurer , IFRC Gratuity & Provident Fund (GPF)

**Job Purpose:**

-   Accurate accounting and timely reporting of all financial activities.
    
-   Transparent processing of contributions, withdrawals, settlements, and loans.
    
-   Compliance with NBR and other regulatory requirements.
    
-   Efficient fund investment management and documentation.
    
-   Effective and responsive communication with fund members.
    

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**  
  
**Financial Management & Accounting:**

-   Maintain full and accurate books of accounts for the GPF Trust using approved accounting software.
    
-   Record all employee and employer contributions, withdrawals, investments, and returns.
    
-   Ensure all transactions are properly documented and entered into the general ledger, bank book, and member ledger.
    
-   Prepare monthly and annual financial statements, including balance sheet, income statement, and notes to accounts.
    
-   Conduct monthly bank reconciliations for all GPF accounts.
    
-   Prepare and support the annual statutory and external audit processes.
    

**Member Account Management and Loan Administration**

-   Maintain individual member accounts showing monthly contributions, withdrawals, loans, interest, and closing balances.
    
-   Process temporary and permanent withdrawal requests and ensure compliance with GPF By-laws and income tax regulations.
    
-   Handle member loan applications:
    
-   Verify eligibility and member balance for loan requests.
    
-   Process loans only upon formal Trustee approval.
    
-   Record loan disbursement and create monthly EMI repayment schedules.
    
-   Record monthly EMI deductions and update loan ledgers.
    
-   Send monthly reminders to members regarding due EMI payments and overdue instalments.
    
-   Follow up with IFRC HR/Finance units (as applicable) for collection of missed EMIs.
    
-   Respond promptly to all member inquiries regarding balances, statements, or loan-related matters through email, phone, or in-person communication.
    
-   Issue annual member statements showing contributions, interest, loan status, and final balances.
    
-   Send Quarterly individual statements to all concern staff (basic statement).
    

**Compliance, Tax, and VAT Management**

-   Ensure full compliance with GPF Trust By-laws, NBR requirements, and relevant financial regulations.
    
-   Calculate and deduct applicable income tax or withholding tax as per government rules.
    
-   Prepare and file all necessary tax and VAT returns or reports to the NBR on time if necessary.
    
-   Maintain updated records of all tax deductions, deposits, and acknowledgments.
    
-   Support the Trust during tax audits or queries raised by NBR or other authorities.
    

**Investment Management**

-   Support the Board of Trustees in identifying, evaluating, and monitoring investment options for GPF Trust funds in accordance with the Trust Deed and By-laws.
    
-   Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all Fund investments with credit rating update of Bank/FI, including fixed deposits, government securities, and other Trustee-approved instruments.
    
-   Track investment maturities, renewal dates, and returns/interest earned, ensuring timely reinvestment or disbursement as directed by the Trustees.
    
-   Prepare periodic investment performance summaries and reports for review by the Board of Trustees.
    
-   Maintain safe custody of all investment-related documents (certificates, contracts, confirmations, renewal notices).
    

**Reporting and Communication**

-   Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and member reports to the Trustees.
    
-   Prepare working documents, resolutions, and financial summaries for Trustee meetings.
    
-   Maintain records and minutes of Trustee meetings and resolutions.

title: Nurse Manager / Junior Nurse Manager under Nursing Services
description:
**Job Context:**

In the context of Bangladesh Specialized Hospital, a Nurse Supervisor oversees and manages the nursing staff and operations, ensuring patient care quality, compliance with regulations, and providing support and guidance to the nursing team, while also handling administrative tasks.

**Job Responsibilities: -**

-   Supervise and manage the nursing staff, including scheduling, assignments, and performance evaluations.
    
-   Assist the total needs of patients in the unit and prepare planned nursing care
    
-   Demonstrate and supervise the nursing care of patients in the unit
    
-   Attend regular round in the unit with the medical and nursing personnel.
    
-   Reviewing reports from In-charge regarding the nursing care of patients in each shift.
    
-   Aids DCNO in coordinating staff leave on the units.
    
-   Aids the Head Nurse / Incharge in all written procedures, assisting define the Staffs when required.
    
-   Plan and arrange duty for nurses & ensure availability of adequate nursing staff in all shifts.
    
-   Advises and counsels nursing staff when required, initiating disciplinary procedures with DCNO.
    
-   Communicate with staff and department In-Charge.
    
-   Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, including documentation of care plans and nursing interventions.
    
-   Ensure that all patients receive appropriate, timely, and effective nursing care.
    
-   Guide the In-charges to ensure supplies and equipment of different stores and re-checking their use and care.
    
-   Periodical check of all stocks and supplies.
    
-   Checks night reports and census sheets from wards, cabin & other dept. for ensuring accuracy.
    
-   Monitor patient outcomes and implement strategies to improve care quality and safety.
    
-   Conduct regular audits and reviews to ensure continuous improvement in patient care and safety standards.
    
-   Daily Check of emergency and dangerous drugs, life saving equipments i.e; monitors, ventilators, defibrillators, suction machines and O2 Points etc. to ensure their proper functioning
    
-   Interact with the engineering services department for proper up keep of the unit.
    
-   Act as a liaison between nursing staff and hospital administration to address issues, concerns, and improvements.
    
-   Informed of the needs of the patient care areas and bring it to their notice any special problems.
    
-   Attends evening/night duty meetings, and occasional day duty meetings, participating in activities as required with an automatic right to place items on agenda.
    
-   Participates in quality assurance programs.
    
-   Initiates and participates in teaching / training sessions.
    
-   Maintain good inter-personnel relationship with all categories of staff, patients and their relatives.
    
-   Ensure compliance with hospital policies, procedures, and regulations, including those related to infection control and patient safety.
    
-   Participate in quality improvement initiatives and ensure adherence to best practices in BSH

title: District Team Leader (DTL) (Readvertisement)
description:
Shushilan, a national reputed NGO is implementing a project entitled the Community Mobilization Programme (CMP) supported by SMC, focused on community engagement, behavior change, and grassroots health promotion. It operates through structured planning NGO partnerships, GSM networks, and BCC interventions such as meetings, training, and promotional campaigns. Shushilan is working in Jhinahdha, Meherpur, Narail, Khulna and Satkhira district.

**Job Description / Responsibility**

-   Lead and oversee the implementation of the Community Mobilization Programme (CMP) across assigned districts, ensuring achievement of project objectives and targets.
    
-   Develop and monitor work plans, implementation strategies, budgets, reporting formats, and operational plans in coordination with the project management team.
    
-   Provide technical guidance, supervision, and operational support to Upazila Supervisors, Community Mobilizers, GSMs, and other field staff.
    
-   Ensure quality and timely implementation of project activities in compliance with organizational and donor requirements.
    
-   Conduct regular field visits to monitor program progress, identify challenges, and provide on-site coaching and mentoring to project staff.
    
-   Coordinate with SMC representatives, including Sales Officers, Area Executives, and other relevant personnel, to ensure effective project implementation.
    
-   Monitor maternal and child health-related activities, including ANC service promotion and community engagement initiatives.
    
-   Ensure proper management and documentation of sales-related activities, including cash memos, stock registers, bank deposits, and related records.
    
-   Supervise district-level administrative, financial, and logistical operations and ensure compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
    
-   Monitor accounts, bookkeeping, and financial documentation to ensure transparency, accountability, and accuracy.
    
-   Implement monitoring tools and systems to track project performance, quality, and outcomes.
    
-   Establish and maintain effective coordination and networking with district and upazila administrations, Health and Family Planning Departments, local government institutions, educational institutions, NGOs, and other stakeholders.
    
-   Facilitate advocacy, coordination meetings, and stakeholder engagement activities to strengthen project visibility and collaboration.
    
-   Prepare case studies, success stories, lessons learned, and other documentation for knowledge sharing and reporting purposes.
    
-   Ensure accurate and timely collection, analysis, validation, and submission of program data and reports.
    
-   Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual programmatic and financial reports to the Project Management Team.
    
-   Maintain proper filing systems and ensure safe custody of all project documents, records, and assets at the district office.
    
    Due to unavoidable circumstances, some changes have been made to the advertisement, particularly regarding the educational qualification (At least Bachelor’s degree) and the experience requirement (minimum 3 years). Therefore, the advertisement is being re-published

title: Manager - Nursery Operations
description:
We are seeking a dynamic, result oriented, and experienced Manager – Nursery Operations to lead our commercial nursery production and landscaping operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for nursery production planning, operational excellence, business development, project implementation, and team leadership to ensure sustainable growth and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

-   Lead and manage all nursery production operations, maximizing land utilization, productivity, and plant species diversity.
    
-   Develop annual and seasonal production plans to ensure timely availability of quality planting materials.
    
-   Oversee propagation, cultivation, irrigation, fertilization, pest and disease management, harvesting, and inventory control.
    
-   Plan, design, and supervise landscaping and plantation projects for government, corporate, institutional, and private clients.
    
-   Build and maintain strategic partnerships with corporate clients, NGOs, government agencies, and institutions to expand nursery business and sales.
    
-   Develop and implement operational efficiency strategies to minimize production costs, reduce input wastage, and improve productivity.
    
-   Manage nursery budgets, procurement, resource allocation, and cost control to achieve financial targets.
    
-   Lead project planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting, and ensure timely completion within budget.
    
-   Coordinate field activities with local authorities, development partners, consultants, and stakeholders.
    
-   Ensure compliance with environmental, quality, safety, and sustainability standards.
    
-   Monitor nursery performance through KPIs and prepare operational reports for management.
    
-   Recruit, train, supervise, and motivate nursery staff while maintaining a high-performance work culture.
    
-   Identify new business opportunities in nursery production, landscaping, plantation, and horticultural services.

**দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য:**

-   কর্মকর্তা ও কর্মচারীদের জন্য প্রতিদিন দুপুরের খাবার এবং প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য খাবার প্রস্তুত করা।

-   খাদ্যসামগ্রীর সঠিক ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা এবং অপচয় কমানো।

In this role, you will coordinate with factories, buyers, and internal departments to ensure compliance with buyers' Code of Conduct, local labor laws, and social compliance standards through effective monitoring, documentation, and timely follow-ups.

We're seeking someone with strong communication skills in English, sound knowledge of social compliance requirements, and a keen interest in maintaining ethical and sustainable workplace practices. This is an excellent opportunity for career growth in a dynamic sourcing company.

**Job Responsibilities**

-   Monitor factory compliance with buyers' Code of Conduct, Bangladesh Labour Law, and company policies.
-   Coordinate with factories and internal teams to prepare for social compliance audits and follow up on audit findings.
-   Prepare and maintain compliance documents, reports, and audit-related records.
-   Follow up on Corrective Action Plans (CAP) to ensure timely implementation and closure.
-   Conduct internal compliance inspections and identify areas for improvement.
-   Communicate effectively with buyers, factories, and stakeholders to resolve compliance-related issues.

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
Job Overview:

The Maintenance Manager is responsible for ensuring all factory machines and equipment are operating efficiently with minimum downtime. The role will lead the maintenance team and oversee the maintenance of approximately 1,000 machines used in denim woven, automation, quilting, and pocket setter operations to support smooth production.

Key Responsibilities:

Plan and manage all maintenance activities for factory machinery and equipment.

Ensure preventive and breakdown maintenance is carried out on time.

Reduce machine downtime and improve machine performance.

Oversee the maintenance of sewing, cutting, finishing, denim, knit, woven, automation, pocket setter and quilting machines.

Troubleshoot and maintain automated equipment, including pocket setter automation systems, to ensure smooth production.

Lead and supervise maintenance engineers, technicians, electricians, and mechanics.

Ensure utility equipment such as generators, boilers, air compressors, electrical systems, and HVAC are properly maintained.

Coordinate with the Production team to ensure uninterrupted factory operations.

Maintain machine maintenance records and prepare regular reports.

Manage spare parts inventory and coordinate with suppliers for required parts.

Ensure all maintenance activities comply with factory safety and compliance requirements.

Support the installation, relocation, and commissioning of new machines when required.

title: Assistant General Manager - Product Development Center | Mirpur

title: General Manager - Quality Control
description:
**Job Context:**

The ideal candidate will ensure world-class quality standards, customer satisfaction, and continuous process improvement from fabric inspection to final shipment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

-   Develop and implement quality strategies, SOPs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
    
-   Ensure compliance with buyer quality standards and international quality requirements.
    
-   Monitor inline, end-line, and final inspection activities to achieve Right First Time (RFT) performance.
    
-   Analyze quality data, identify root causes of defects, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
    
-   Coordinate with Merchandising, Production, Industrial Engineering, Washing, and Technical teams to resolve quality issues.
    
-   Handle buyer audits, technical visits, and third-party quality inspections.

title: CRM Executive
description:

title: Head of Finance & Accounts

title: Operation Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our restaurant outlets in Dhaka ( Dhanmondi ,Banani, Uttara, Bashundhara) . -   Conduct regular branch inspections and operational audits.
-   Ensure excellent customer service and resolve customer complaints professionally.
-   Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports and recommend improvement strategies.

title: Assistant Officer (Computer)
description:
**I & I Services Ltd.:**

I & I Services Ltd. operates as a pharmaceutical distribution unit with multiple depots located across different regions. The company is responsible for delivering medicines to various customers or healthcare facilities and collecting the corresponding payments upon delivery. Their operations involve managing inventory at each depot, ensuring timely and accurate distribution, and maintaining efficient cash collection processes to support smooth business operations.

**Job Summary:**

The Computer Operator – IT is responsible for accurate and timely processing of sales orders, invoicing, inventory reconciliation, and system-based reporting within the pharmaceutical warehouse. The role ensures proper implementation of sales policies, maintenance of data integrity, and generation of critical sales and stock reports including expiry, damaged, and short-dated products. The position supports warehouse and sales operations by ensuring error-free documentation, timely reporting, and contributing to zero customer complaints through precise system handling and compliance with company procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Order Processing & Invoicing**

-   Receive sales orders from the system and prepare accurate invoices in timely manner.
    
-   Perform product allocations in the system to reflect correct dispatch quantities and inventory movements.
    
-   Coordinate with sales and distribution teams to ensure documentation aligns with operational schedules.
    
-   Implement company sales policies during invoice preparation for _retail and institutional customers_.
    

**Returns and Reconciliation**

-   Receive return invoices from Distribution Agents (DAs).
    
-   Prepare consolidated **Sales Summary** for effective stock reconciliation.
    
-   Work closely with warehouse personnel to adjust inventory in system after returns.
    
-   Ensure returns processing supports accurate stock reporting and financial reconciliation.
    

**Reporting Duties**

-   Generate and distribute daily/weekly/monthly sales reports per business requirement.
    
-   Prepare critical inventory management reports including:
    
    -   **Expiry Report**
        
    -   **Damaged & Short-Dated Product Report**
        
    -   **Sales Performance Metrics**
        
-   Ensure reports are uploaded/distributed to relevant departments and stakeholders on time.
    

**Data & System Management**

-   Maintain and update database records within company software (ERP/WMS/MS Office) accurately.
    
-   Ensure database integrity by validating entries and correcting discrepancies immediately.
    
-   Archive digital reports and maintain backups as per IT QA protocols.
    

**Quality & Compliance**

-   Ensure zero customer complaints through accurate data handling and thorough validation before submission of invoices or reports.
    
-   Work in compliance with internal SOPs, GMP and IT data protocols.
    
-   Assist in standardizing reporting formats and digital workflows to minimize errors.
    

**Cross-Functional Support**

-   Support internal audits by providing required sales & inventory data promptly.
    
-   Work with IT teams to troubleshoot software issues affecting sales, reporting or data retrieval.
    
-   Support training for staff on basic data entry procedures where applicable.

title: Executive/ Senior Executive – Export (Food & Beverage Business)

-   Coordinate with Production, Warehouse, Quality Assurance, Logistics, and Commercial teams to ensure timely order fulfillment and shipment execution.

-   Perform any other responsibilities assigned by Management from time to time.

title: Marketing Automation Executive (CSE Background)
description:
**Company:** CARBARN

**Industry:** Australia-Based Automotive Industry

**Working Hours:** 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

## About the Role

CARBARN is looking for a smart, responsible, and technically capable **Marketing Automation Executive** to join our team.

This role is ideal for someone with a **Computer Science or CSE background** who is interested in marketing, AI automation, workflow development, data management, and business process improvement.

The selected candidate will work closely with our marketing, operations, and technical teams to develop automated marketing workflows, manage customer and lead data, improve campaign performance, and reduce repetitive manual work.

The ideal candidate should be organized, analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with marketing platforms, APIs, automation tools, databases, and AI-powered systems.

-   Develop and manage marketing automation workflows for lead generation, follow-ups, email campaigns, customer engagement, and reporting

-   Collect, organize, clean, and manage lead and customer data from different platforms

-   Assist in creating automated email marketing campaigns using dynamic HTML templates
-   Integrate websites, CRM systems, databases, spreadsheets, email platforms, and third-party services
-   Use APIs and webhooks to transfer data between different systems
-   Monitor automated workflows and quickly identify and resolve errors
-   Create marketing reports, dashboards, campaign summaries, and performance tracking systems
-   Assist with customer segmentation based on behaviour, vehicle interest, lead source, location, and engagement level
-   Use AI to analyse customer conversations, classify leads, generate communication drafts, and improve follow-up processes
-   Support Facebook, Google, email, website, and other digital marketing activities through automation and data analysis
-   Work with the technical team to improve internal marketing systems and software tools
-   Maintain proper documentation for workflows, integrations, scripts, and automation processes
-   Research and test new AI tools, automation platforms, and practical marketing technologies
-   Continuously explore ways to improve marketing efficiency, lead response time, data accuracy, and customer communication

## Why Join CARBARN?

At CARBARN, you will have the opportunity to work on real business automation projects within the Australian automotive industry. You will gain practical experience in marketing technology, AI automation, system integration, data management, and workflow development while contributing directly to business growth and operational efficiency.

We are looking for someone who is ready to learn, take responsibility, contribute ideas, and help us build smarter marketing systems.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Remote | Immediate Start | Initial One-Month Contract**

We need a proactive, hands-on DevOps engineer to take a small but messy infrastructure estate and turn it into a clean, secure and easy-to-manage production platform.

This is not an audit-only or advisory role.

You will own the full cycle:

**Review → Protect → Clean Up → Standardise → Deploy → Test → Document → Handover**

## Current Estate

The environment includes approximately:

-   9 Linux VPS servers
-   websites, applications, APIs and services
-   Docker, Docker Compose and Coolify
-   PostgreSQL, Redis and BullMQ
-   Next.js, Node.js, Strapi and PWAs
-   Cloudflare DNS, SSL, WAF and R2
-   GitHub and self-hosted Gitea
-   Several WordPress and cPanel environments
-   A local Docker and AI development machine

Most applications are already built or substantially complete. The priority is to clean up the estate, protect what is working and establish a reliable company-controlled deployment process.

## First Priority: Days 1–2

The first task will be to work with our WordPress team to tidy, secure and redeploy the existing cPanel and WordPress estate.

This includes:

-   mapping all WordPress sites, domains, databases and hosting accounts;
-   confirming backups before changes;
-   reviewing PHP versions, SSL, plugins, themes and security;
-   cleaning up abandoned or duplicated installations;
-   resolving broken routing, database or deployment issues;
-   redeploying the agreed WordPress sites cleanly;
-   confirming each site is live, backed up and manageable;
-   documenting the completed WordPress and cPanel setup.

Once the WordPress estate is stable, you will move into the wider infrastructure audit and deployment work.

## Wider Responsibilities

You will:

-   audit all servers, containers, domains, repositories, databases, queues and environments;
-   map each application to its server, repository, database and deployment;
-   compare live code against Git and preserve any live-only changes;
-   create and verify backups before making structural changes;
-   standardise GitHub, Gitea, Docker and Coolify;
-   implement protected branches, pull requests and owner-approved Production releases;
-   establish a clear deployment flow:

**Development → Staging 2 → Staging 1 / Pre-production → Production**

-   separate databases, credentials, Redis/BullMQ services and storage where required;
-   fix routing, environment variables, persistent volumes, networking and reverse proxies;
-   deploy and stabilise the remaining applications;
-   review Cloudflare DNS, SSL, caching, WAF and R2;
-   configure monitoring, logging, health checks and restart policies;
-   implement tested application rollback and database recovery;
-   clean up the local AI and Docker machine;
-   remove obsolete services only after backup and approval;
-   produce clear documentation and train the internal team.

## Production Safety

No destructive Production change may be made without:

1.  a verified backup;
2.  a documented rollback plan;
3.  explicit owner approval.

The project is complete only when the agreed estate is deployed, tested, backed up, documented and handed over.

## AI-Assisted Deployments

We use Codex and other AI development tools heavily.

You must be comfortable deploying AI-assisted builds, reviewing Dockerfiles, environment variables, dependencies and logs, and working with developers to resolve application-level issues.

Blind deployment is not acceptable. You remain responsible for infrastructure validation and deployment safety.

## Required Experience

Strong practical experience with most of the following:

-   Linux VPS administration
-   Docker and Docker Compose
-   Coolify or a similar platform
-   GitHub and Gitea
-   PostgreSQL backup and recovery
-   Redis and BullMQ
-   Cloudflare
-   Nginx or Traefik
-   Monitoring and logging
-   WordPress and cPanel
-   Next.js, Node.js or Strapi deployments

Kubernetes is not required. We want simple, reliable and maintainable infrastructure.

## Team Support

You will receive daily support from:

-   Founder: approximately **06:00–15:00 ICT**
-   Technical lead and team: approximately **15:00–03:00 ICT**
-   WordPress developers for the initial cPanel cleanup
-   Application developers for code-level fixes
-   Codex-generated audits and deployment packs

You must be available for meaningful daily overlap with the team, ideally including **12:00–16:00 ICT**.

## Contract

-   Immediate start
-   Remote
-   Initial one-month contract
-   Must be your primary project
-   Daily progress reporting required
-   Possible ongoing work after successful completion

-   SQL Server basics and database backup (preferred).
    
-   Hardware and software troubleshooting.
    
-   CCTV, biometric attendance, and access control systems.
    
-   Data backup, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity awareness.
    
-   Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

-   Resolve user support requests within agreed SLAs.

description:
**Company Overview**

A Narayanganj-based knit garments manufacturing company located in the BSCIC Industrial Area, operating a compact manufacturing facility with a workforce of approximately 500–1000 employees. The factory specializes in knit apparel manufacturing with core functions including knitting, dyeing, sewing, and fabric-related operations.

**Role Overview**

The Factory GM will be responsible for leading the overall factory operations and ensuring seamless coordination across all departments. This role requires an industry expert with strong technical and operational expertise in knit garments who can independently manage the factory, optimize production efficiency, maintain quality standards, and ensure effective coordination among Production, Quality, Maintenance, Merchandising, Store, HR & Administration, Compliance, and other support functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

-   Lead and oversee the overall factory operations, ensuring smooth day-to-day management of all departments.
    
-   Manage production planning and execution across Knitting, Dyeing, Sewing, and other related operations.
    
-   Supervise yarn procurement and coordinate with the Fabric Department to ensure uninterrupted production.
    
-   Ensure effective coordination among Production, Quality, Maintenance, Merchandising, Store, HR & Administration, Compliance, and other support functions.
    
-   Develop and implement operational strategies to improve productivity, reduce wastage, and enhance factory performance.
    
-   Manage workforce planning, employee discipline, and industrial relations while maintaining a positive working environment.
    
-   Handle worker unions and resolve labor-related issues in compliance with Bangladesh Labour Law and company policies.

PLEASE READ EVERY LINE BEFORE APPLYING

The Lead UI/UX Designer must have a strong understanding of North American design standards, user behavior, and digital product expectations. This includes designing clean, modern, accessible, conversion-focused, and user-centered experiences rather than following regional design trends that may not resonate with our target audience. The ideal candidate should stay up to date with global design trends, conduct research on competitor products, understand Western consumer psychology, and make design decisions based on user experience, data, and best practices. They should be capable of delivering premium, scalable, and market-ready digital products that meet the expectations of North American clients while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistency across every project.

-   **Design and Prototype:** Create engaging and effective user interfaces and user experiences for web and mobile applications. Develop wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
-   **User Research:** Conduct user research and usability testing to understand user needs and behaviors. Analyze feedback to inform design decisions.
-   **Collaboration:** Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into design solutions.
-   **Design Standards:** Maintain and enhance design systems and guidelines to ensure consistency and quality across products.
-   **Iteration:** Iterate on designs based on feedback, testing, and evolving project requirements.
-   **Trend Awareness:** Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies to bring fresh ideas and innovative solutions to the team.

title: Medical Coordinator
description:
**Job Circular No.:** **20260727-010**

**Reports To:** Sr. Project Manager/ Project Coordinator

**Job Location:** Ukhiya, Cox’s Bazar with frequent visits to other operational locations

Research, Training and Management (RTM) International NGO working in the Cox’s Bazar to implement different projects supported by Government of Bangladesh, UNFPA, UNICEF and others development partners. To support the UNFPA funder project implementation, RTMI requires to fill up the vacancy for the position of Medical Coordinator. This position is responsible for the following tasks:

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Technical Leadership and Quality Assurance**

-   Serve as the technical focal point for health-facility response plans, clinical operations and service-related inquiries.
    
-   Provide technical support and guidance to frontline health-facility staff to ensure the delivery of high-quality SRH and SRHR services.
    
-   Ensure that clinical services comply with applicable Ministry of Health, WHO, regulatory and project standards.
    
-   Conduct regular clinical reviews and quality audits, identify service gaps and support facility teams in implementing corrective actions.
    
-   Promote evidence-based practices and ensure the accountability, predictability and effectiveness of humanitarian health interventions.
    
-   Provide technical guidance and supportive supervision to midwives and other clinical staff to ensure adherence to professional and regulatory standards.
    

**Programme Implementation and Field Monitoring**

-   Support the timely, effective and coordinated implementation of SRHR activities using participatory and community-based approaches.
    
-   Maintain regular communication with health-facility teams through frequent monitoring and supervisory visits.
    
-   Prepare field-monitoring plans to assess program progress and identify service gaps, operational challenges and areas requiring improvement.
    
-   Develop practical, innovative, and cost-effective recommendations to address identified challenges.
    
-   Work closely with medical officers, midwives, paramedics, laboratory technicians and other health-sector personnel in designing and implementing SRHR interventions.
    
-   Ensure the timely implementation of agreed action plans and follow up on recommendations arising from monitoring visits.
    

**Clinical Supervision and Capacity Development**

-   Supervise clinical practices and provide technical support to doctors, midwives, paramedics, and other service providers.
    
-   Organize Continuing Medical Education (CME), clinical orientations, mentoring sessions, and other capacity-development activities.
    
-   Identify the training and professional-development needs of health-facility personnel and arrange appropriate support.
    
-   Support the preparation and implementation of staff duty rosters and annual leave plans within available resources.
    
-   Periodically review medical records, patient-admission procedures, clinical documentation, and other relevant service-delivery processes.
    

**Medicines, Commodities and Supply Management**

-   Ensure the appropriate distribution, availability, and rational use of medicines, medical commodities, equipment, and supplies provided by RTMI, UNFPA or other partners.
    
-   Coordinate with the Project Logistician to monitor medicine consumption, supply orders, stock levels and inventory records.
    
-   Ensure that sufficient stocks are maintained to support uninterrupted service delivery.
    
-   Train and guide relevant staff on proper inventory management and the rational use of medical supplies and other project resources.
    
-   Promptly identify and report stock shortages, unusual consumption patterns, and supply-chain concerns.
    

**Data Management, Reporting and Documentation**

-   Supervise administrative and clinical documentation to ensure that project information remains complete, accurate, and up to date.
    
-   Analyse routine service data to monitor programme performance and support evidence-based decision-making.
    
-   Prepare regular updates and reports on SRHR services, health-facility operations, identified challenges, and corrective measures.
    
-   Communicate relevant instructions and updates received from government authorities, donors, and other stakeholders to the concerned teams.
    
-   Ensure that medical records, monitoring findings, audit results, and programme documents are properly maintained.
    

**Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement**

-   Coordinate closely with government authorities, donors, health-sector partners, community representatives, and other relevant stakeholders.
    
-   Attend health-sector, emergency-response, and other relevant coordination meetings.
    
-   Represent the project in meetings with the Government of Bangladesh, donors, UN agencies, and national and international stakeholders, as assigned.
    
-   Facilitate visits by donors, government representatives, and national or international delegates and provide appropriate briefings on project health services and achievements.
    
-   Promote effective coordination among health facilities and other health-sector actors to prevent duplication and address service gaps.
    

**Emergency Preparedness and Community Health**

-   Support the planning and implementation of emergency health-response activities.
    
-   Incorporate early recovery, preparedness, prevention and risk-reduction considerations into emergency interventions.
    
-   Provide technical guidance on community-awareness and risk-communication messages during public-health emergencies.
    
-   Ensure that emergency health interventions remain coordinated, evidence-based, and responsive to community needs.
    

**Other Responsibilities**

-   Perform any other duties assigned by the Project Coordinator, Project Manager, or appropriate authority.
    
-   Responsibilities may be revised or adapted according to RTMI’s operational requirements and the specific needs of the project.

title: Sr. Executive / Executive- IE & PPC
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

-   **Industrial Engineering (IE):**
    -   Conduct time and motion studies to establish accurate Standard Allowed Minutes (SAM) / SMV for various garment styles.
    -   Monitor daily line balancing, workstation layout, and bottleneck identification to maximize floor productivity.
    -   Assist in implementing lean manufacturing tools, 5S, and continuous improvement (Kaizen) practices on the production floor.
    -   Evaluate operator efficiency, track helper utilization, and help manage incentive or target-setting systems.
-   **Production Planning & Control (PPC):**
    -   Assist in preparing and updating master production schedules and daily loading plans.
    -   Coordinate with the merchandising and store departments to track TNA (Time & Action Calendar) and ensure timely availability of fabrics and trims.
    -   Monitor Work-in-Process (WIP) inventory levels across lines to prevent accumulation and reduce lead times.
    -   Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production status reports, efficiency logs, and shipment tracking documents.

title: Manager - IE & PPC
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

-   **Industrial Engineering (IE):**
    -   Conduct method studies, time studies, motion economy, and workstation layout optimization to minimize bottlenecks.
    -   Establish standard allowed minutes (SAM) and SMV for new and existing styles.
    -   Monitor line balancing, capacity studies, and layout planning to achieve optimal factory efficiency and productivity targets.
    -   Implement lean manufacturing tools (5S, Kaizen, Kanban, Value Stream Mapping) across the production floor.
    -   Manage incentive schemes, target settings, and manpower cost optimization.
-   **Production Planning & Control (PPC):**
    -   Formulate master production schedules (MPS) based on order bookings, TNA (Time & Action Calendar), and factory capacity.
    -   Coordinate closely with merchandising, commercial, and production floors to ensure uninterrupted raw material flow (fabrics, trims, accessories).
    -   Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production progress against targets and re-schedule dynamically to avert delays.
    -   Manage WIP (Work in Process) inventory levels to reduce lead times and improve working capital efficiency.
    -   Oversee shipment planning and ensure 100% on-time delivery (OTD) to buyers.
-   **Reporting & Leadership:**
    -   Lead, mentor, and train the IE and planning team members.
    -   Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on efficiency, line utilization, bottlenecks, and shipment status for top management reviews.

title: Front Desk Executive - Female
description:
At Diverse Style Ltd, we blend creativity, style, and elegance to create unique fashion experiences. As a leading fashion house & manufacturer , our Office, Factory & Studio is a high-energy environment where designers, clients, and creatives cross paths. We are looking for a poised, articulate, and fashion-forward **Front Desk Executive** to be the face and voice of our brand.

As our Front Desk Executive, you are the first point of contact for our VIP clients, designers, and visitors. You will manage the reception area with grace, ensuring a luxury experience from the moment someone walks through the door or calls our studio. This role requires a mix of impeccable administrative skills, stellar communication, and a passion for the fashion industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

-   **Brand Ambassadorship:** Greet clients, designers, and guests warmly, offering a premium hospitality experience (handling refreshments, coat check, etc.).
    
-   **Front Desk Management:** Answer and route incoming phone calls, manage emails, and handle general inquiries about collections, fittings, and Office/Factory/Studio hours.
    
-   **Scheduling & Coordination:** Manage the calendar for client fittings, design consultations, and executive meetings.
    
-   **Showroom Elegance:** Maintain the visual appeal and cleanliness of the reception and front waiting area, ensuring it aligns with our company aesthetic.
    
-   **Administrative Support:** Handle incoming/outgoing couriers (samples, fabrics, PR packages), manage basic office inventory, and assist the retail or management team with light data entry.

description:
-   Independently manage all VAT and Tax-related affairs of the company.

-   Maintain all VAT registers, Mushak forms, and statutory records as required under the VAT & SD Act and Rules.
    
-   Handle VAT registration (BIN), amendments, VAT deduction at source (VDS), withholding tax (TDS), A-Challan, and other regulatory compliance.
    
-   Coordinate and correspond with the National Board of Revenue (NBR), VAT Commissionerate, Income Tax authorities, and other regulatory bodies.
    
-   Handle VAT and Tax audits, assessments, inspections, notices, and related proceedings independently.
    
-   Ensure proper documentation, reconciliation, and compliance of VAT and Tax records.

-   Professional training in Commercial, Import-Export, or International Trade will be an added advantage.
    

* * *

## Experience Requirements

-   **Minimum 4–8 years of direct Commercial experience in a Food & Beverage manufacturing company.**
    
-   Practical experience in importing production materials for **Juices, Soft Drinks, Energy Drinks, Sauces, Noodles, Snacks, or similar Food & Beverage products.**
    
-   Hands-on experience in importing **ingredients, flavors, concentrates, additives, packaging materials, machinery, engineering spare parts, food-grade resins, and industrial chemicals.**
    
-   Proven experience working directly with international suppliers, including sourcing, supplier evaluation, commercial negotiation, and relationship management.

* * *

Applicants from other industries or without practical experience in importing Food & Beverage production materials are requested not to apply.**

## **Role Overview**

-   Analyze marketing data and prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights.
    
-   Collaborate with content, design, development, and sales teams to achieve marketing objectives.

title: Sr. Manager/ AGM- HR, Admin & Compliance- Knit Garments
description:
**1\. HR Management for Factory Operations:**

-   Develop and implement HR policies tailored to factory-level operations and workforce needs.
    
-   Oversee recruitment and onboarding of factory workers and staff, ensuring alignment with production demands.
    
-   Manage timekeeping, attendance systems, and payroll accuracy for factory employees.
    
-   Foster a positive and disciplined work environment on the factory floor.
    
-   Address and resolve grievances from factory workers and staff efficiently.
    

**2\. Administrative Oversight of Factory Premises:**

-   Ensure smooth operations of all factory administrative functions, including utilities, maintenance, and housekeeping.
    
-   Oversee the factory’s transport, canteen, and dormitory facilities (if applicable).
    
-   Establish and enforce protocols for managing factory emergencies, including fire, natural disasters, and industrial accidents.
    
-   Monitor and control factory-related administrative budgets and expenses.
    

**3\. Compliance Management for Factory Operations:**

-   Ensure the factory complies with all labor laws, safety regulations, and international compliance standards (e.g., BSCI, WRAP, SEDEX).
    
-   Conduct regular internal audits of factory processes to identify and address compliance gaps.
    
-   Liaise with external auditors, buyers, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance readiness.
    
-   Develop and implement safety programs to minimise workplace injuries and hazards.
    

**4\. Security and Discipline (Factory Premises):**

-   Leverage military experience to maintain high standards of discipline and security across the factory premises.
    
-   Implement effective access control measures and monitor factory premises for safety and security risks.
    
-   Train and supervise security personnel to handle emergencies, including theft, fire, and unrest.
    
-   Address and mitigate worker unrest or dispute risks in collaboration with HR and legal teams.
    

**5\. Employee Well-being and Productivity (Factory Focus):**

-   Monitor and improve factory workers’ living and working conditions, such as clean water, sanitation, and a healthy work environment.
    
-   Organize training sessions on workplace safety, health, and rights awareness—Foster teamwork and productivity by promoting fairness and mutual respect.
    

**6\. Strategic Leadership in Factory Operations:**

-   Work closely with factory management to align HR, admin, and compliance functions with production goals.
    
-   Use factory performance data to make informed decisions regarding resource allocation and workforce planning.
    
-   Act as a bridge between senior management and the factory-level workforce to maintain open communication.
    

7 . Any other assignments assigned by the Company management

title: Intern Program
description:
Internship Program 2 Openings

Tracks: Recruiter | Marketing

ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Silicon Orchard Ltd. is a Dhaka-based custom software development company delivering AI, web and mobile, cloud, and quality-engineering solutions to clients across three continents. We are opening a three-to-six-month, primarily remote internship program with two tracks Recruiter and Marketing. Both roles support a U.S.-based client, so working hours follow U.S. Eastern Time (ET). The position is remote, though occasional visits to our Dhaka, Bangladesh office may be required. It is a hands-on opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals and build real experience.

All interviews are conducted in English, and strong English communication is expected across both tracks. Across both tracks, candidates must have prior hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to create, edit, modify, and refine documents, requirements, and files as part of their daily work. Candidates who perform excellently during the internship will have the opportunity to join Silicon Orchard in a junior full-time role. Prior familiarity with the tools and platforms listed under each track is strongly preferred.

# Track 1  Recruiter Intern

**OVERVIEW**

Support our talent acquisition team in sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates for software, AI, and design roles. Ideal for someone naturally curious who loves to explore new things and learn how tech hiring works end to end.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

-   Source candidates across job portals, LinkedIn, and developer communities.
    
-   Review and shortlist resumes against role requirements.
    
-   Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations with candidates.
    
-   Maintain and update the candidate database / applicant tracking system.
    
-   Coordinate interview scheduling between candidates and hiring managers.
    
-   Research talent-market trends and new sourcing channels.
    

**REQUIREMENTS**

-   Naturally curious eager to explore new things and always learning.
    
-   Fluent in English, written and verbal.
    
-   Working knowledge of major job portals (e.g., LinkedIn, Indeed, BDJobs).
    
-   Organized, responsive, and detail-oriented.
    
-   Prior hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to create, edit, modify, and refine documents, requirements, and files.
    

**TOOLS & PLATFORMS (EXPERIENCE PREFERRED)**

LinkedIn, Indeed, BDJobs, Boolean search techniques, ATS/CRM tools (e.g., Zoho Recruit or similar), and Google Workspace / Microsoft Office.

# Track 2  Marketing Intern

**OVERVIEW**

Support Silicon Orchard's brand-building and digital marketing across content, social media, and campaigns. We're looking for a fluent, trend-aware, and creative intern who understands how to promote a brand and engage an audience.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

-   Create, schedule, and publish social media content.
    
-   Research current marketing and technology trends and competitor activity.
    
-   Support content, email campaigns, and newsletters.
    
-   Draft posts, captions, and promotional copy that stays on-brand.
    
-   Track campaign performance metrics and prepare simple reports.
    

**REQUIREMENTS**

-   Fluent in English, written and verbal.
    
-   Up to date on current marketing and social media trends.
    
-   Understands how to promote a brand and grow audience engagement.
    
-   Familiar with major platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X).
    
-   Prior hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to create, edit, modify, and refine content, documents, and files.
    

**TOOLS & PLATFORMS (EXPERIENCE PREFERRED)**

Design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite), social schedulers (e.g., Buffer, Hootsuite, Later), email/marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot), and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, LinkedIn/Meta insights).

**What You'll Gain & How to Apply**

WHY JOIN

-   Remote 3–6 month internship with a monthly stipend of BDT 15,000 (occasional visits to our Dhaka office may be required).
    
-   Hands-on experience working with an established software and AI company.
    
-   Mentorship from experienced professionals across your chosen track.
    
-   A clear path forward top performers may be offered a junior full-time role.
    

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume to careers@siliconorchard.com and mention your preferred track Recruiter or Marketing in the email subject line. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed in English.

Silicon Orchard Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
description:
ZHB Solutions is a U.S.-based technology company specializing in cloud infrastructure, managed hosting, enterprise software development, artificial intelligence, managed IT services, insurance technology, and real estate technology. Our mission is to build secure, scalable, and AI-powered multihomed hosting and colocation business, operating its own IPv4 address block and ASN. We're looking for a Network & Systems Engineer to build out our BGP routing infrastructure and server/virtualization platform from the ground up to provide cloud solutions for businesses in the United States and internationally. We foster an AI-first engineering culture where automation, innovation, and continuous learning are core to everything we do. We are looking for a highly motivated **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer/**Network & Systems Engineer to help build and operate the cloud infrastructure behind **ZHB Cloud**.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

-   Configure and manage BGP sessions with multiple upstream transit providers
    

-   Set up and maintain IRR route objects and RPKI ROAs for our IP space
    

-   Test and validate multihomed failover between transit providers
    

-   Deploy and manage a virtualization platform (Proxmox VE or KVM) for VPS and dedicated server hosting
    

-   Provision and maintain dedicated servers, Shared Web Hosting, and Business Email Hosting for customers
    

-   Implement DDoS mitigation and traffic filtering
    

-   Configure DNS, SSL certificates, Cloudflare, VPNs, and firewalls
    

-   Set up and maintain monitoring for uptime, bandwidth, backups, and hardware health
    

-   Develop automation scripts (Bash/Python) for routine operational tasks
    

-   Troubleshoot routing, connectivity, and hardware issues as they arise
    

-   Prepare clear technical documentation and operational procedures

**\*\*\* Job Responsibilities:  
**

-   Adhere to CDD's Children and Adults at Risk Safeguarding policy, ensuring the safety and well-being of all project participants.

-   Report any safeguarding concerns promptly and follow the designated reporting procedures.
    

**Additional Responsibilities:**

-   Perform any other responsibility/ special duty delegated by project and CDD management.
    

.

.

.

**\*\*\* Job Context:**

-   The Centre for Disability in Development (CDD) is a non-profit organization established in 1996 to develop a more inclusive society for persons with disabilities. CDD simultaneously builds technical capacities of the development stakeholders and the communities in how to be more inclusive whilst also enabling persons with a disability to participate in society by strengthening their leadership and providing them with essential rehabilitation and other supports.

title: Manager/ Sr. Manager - Compliance
description:
**Job Context**

We are one of the largest trims and packaging manufacturing companies in Bangladesh, committed to maintaining the highest standards of social, ethical, and regulatory compliance. We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Compliance Manager to join our team and ensure that our operations meet both local and international compliance requirements.

 **Job Responsibilities**

-   Ensure adherence to local labor laws, international standards, and buyer-specific requirements to maintain operational integrity.
-   Lead and support audits including SEDEX (4 Pillar), NIRAPON, HIGG FEM & FSLM, ISO 14001, GRS, GOTS, and Buyer COC, working collaboratively with brands and third-party auditors.
-   Maintain up-to-date documentation and ensure compliance with Nirapon standards, particularly regarding structural and fire safety protocols.
-   Design and implement internal audits to ensure readiness for external audits covering labor, safety, environmental, and ethical standards.
-   Manage and oversee the effective use of customer and government web portals for reporting and compliance processes.
-   Act as the key liaison with government bodies, including Fire & Civil Defense, Labor Office, Factory Inspectorate, and Environmental Inspectorate, ensuring full regulatory compliance.
-   Manage compliance-related purchases by coordinating with the supply chain and suppliers.
-   Conduct job safety analyses and risk assessments, and implement specialized training programs to promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
-   Prepare monthly compliance reports and presentations and submit them to management for review.
-   Regularly review and update workplace policies relating to labor standards, occupational safety, and environmental sustainability.
-   Oversee the timely renewal and maintenance of legal permits (e.g., Trade, Fire, Factory, Environmental, Generator, Explosive licenses) and ensure proper documentation.
-   Lead sustainability initiatives by managing energy, water, and waste to help achieve the company’s environmental goals.
-   Supervise and validate testing for compliance with ZDHC and other standards concerning water quality, wastewater discharge, air emissions, noise levels, and lighting conditions.
-   Monitor and manage chemical inventories, update bilingual MSDS, and enforce strong on-site chemical safety measures.
-   Deliver comprehensive training sessions related to compliance, occupational safety, and environmental management.
-   Support senior management through the timely execution of tasks and special projects aligned with company objectives.

The role involves building and maintaining strong relationships with manpower recruitment agencies, visa processing agencies, travel agencies, corporate organizations, physicians, hospitals, clinics, and other referral partners to drive sustainable business growth. title: Manager, Payroll
description:
Alam Textile & Garments is seeking a highly competent and detail-oriented **Manager, Payroll** to centralize payroll operations for all business concerns from the Corporate Office.

This role is responsible for developing standardized payroll processes, ensuring statutory compliance, strengthening payroll governance, and delivering accurate and timely salary administration across manufacturing units, retail operations, corporate offices, and sister concerns.

## **Key Responsibilities**

-   Manage the end-to-end payroll operations for all concerns of Alam's from the Corporate Office.
    
-   Develop and implement standardized payroll policies, procedures, controls, and service delivery models across all business units.
    
-   Ensure accurate and timely processing of monthly payroll, wages, incentives, overtime, bonuses, leave encashment, final settlements, and other employee benefits.
    
-   Verify payroll inputs including attendance, leave records, shift schedules, overtime, production incentives, and employee movements before payroll processing.
    
-   Ensure full compliance with the Bangladesh Labour Act, Labour Rules, Income Tax Ordinance, company policies, and other statutory requirements.
    
-   Coordinate closely with HR, Finance, Factory Administration, Retail Operations, and departmental heads to ensure payroll accuracy and resolve payroll-related issues.
    
-   Lead payroll budgeting, cost analysis, manpower cost reporting, salary reconciliation, and MIS reporting for management.
    
-   Manage payroll software/HRIS, recommend automation initiatives, and continuously improve payroll efficiency and internal controls.
    
-   Conduct payroll audits and ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity of employee payroll data.
    
-   Supervise and develop the payroll team through coaching, performance management, and process improvement initiatives.
    
-   Prepare payroll-related reports and dashboards for senior management to support strategic decision-making.
    
-   Act as the organization's payroll subject matter expert and ensure a high standard of employee service regarding payroll queries.
    

## **Educational Requirements**

-   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
    
-   Professional certifications in Payroll, HR, Finance, ERP, or Compliance will be considered an added advantage.
    

## **Experience Requirements**

-   5–7 years of relevant payroll experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
    
-   Experience managing payroll for large manufacturing, retail, or multi-business organizations with a sizeable workforce is highly preferred.
    
-   Experience in centralized payroll operations and payroll transformation initiatives will be an added advantage.

Possesses strong working knowledge of the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006 and Bangladesh Labour Rules 2015, statutory benefits administration (Provident Fund, Gratuity), and the confidential handling of sensitive personnel data. Adept at fostering positive employee relations, maintaining compliance with company policies and local regulations, and supporting an engaged, high-performing workforce. An effective communicator in both English and Bengali, comfortable working under pressure while upholding the highest standards of integrity and confidentiality.

**Key Responsibilities & HR Operations**

title: Executive, Finance
description:
Detail-oriented Finance Executive with 5-7 years of hands-on experience in accounting, commercial operations, and financial compliance, preferably within the FinTech, MFS, or banking sectors. Proficient in day-to-day bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, and the management of accounts receivable and payable, alongside the preparation and timely submission of statutory VAT and Tax returns in line with National Board of Revenue (NBR) requirements. Experienced in maintaining accurate books of accounts using ERP platforms (Odoo/Tally), supporting monthly and annual financial closings, and ensuring audit-ready documentation. Possesses a sound understanding of Bangladesh Bank\`s regulatory framework for Payment Service Operators, settlement account handling, and standard commercial banking documentation. A dependable team player able to work under pressure and deliver transparent, accurate, and timely financial records.

**Key Responsibilities & Financial Operations**

-   Maintain regular cash and bank vouchers and assist in accurate daily accounting entries.
    
-   Perform monthly bank reconciliations and assist in general ledger and sub-ledger maintenance.
    
-   Assist in the appropriate calculation, deduction, and timely submission of Tax (TDS/AIT) and VAT to the NBR.
    
-   Monitor sales invoices, manage accounts receivable and payable, and follow up for timely collections.
    
-   Maintain regular communication with banks for daily transactions, statements, and settlement/fund-position inquiries.
    
-   Process vendor payments and prepare cheques, RTGS, and BEFTN instructions with proper supporting documentation.
    
-   Maintain accurate books of accounts in the designated ERP/accounting software.
    
-   Support the finance team during monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial closings and statutory audits.
    
-   Keep all financial documents, files, and records organized and audit-ready.
    
-   Perform any other finance or accounting-related tasks assigned by management.
