title: Community Nutrition Supervisor (Nutritionist)

company.name: Society for Health Extension and Development (SHED)

description:
Society for Health Extension and Development (SHED) a National NGO working in Cox\`s Bazar district is inviting applications from suitable candidates for its Programme title ‘Integrated Nutrition Interventions for Malnutrition Treatment and Prevention in Rohingya Camps & Host communities in Cox\`s Bazar’. The Programme is jointly funded by UNICEF & UNWFP. SHED is looking for qualified candidates for the post of: **Community Nutrition Supervisor (Nutritionist)**

-   **Department:** Health and Nutrition
    
-   **No of Position(s):** Undefined
    
-   **Duration:** Till 31st December 2026 with a high possibility of extension by next year.
    
-   **Job Nature:** Full-time
    
-   **Job Location:** At anywhere in Ukhia/Teknaf Upazila (Camp area).
    

**Job Context:**

Responsible for leading community-based nutrition activities including screening and referral of wasting cases, follow-up home visits, closely working with the Lead mother in rolling out MtMSG activity, coordination and liaison at camp level, supportive supervision and reporting and conflict management at camp level. This position will also support in Integrated Nutrition Facility that includes Outpatient Therapeutic Programme (OTP), Targeted Supplementary Feeding Programme (TSFP) Blanket Supplementary Feeding Programme (BSFP), IYCF, ECCD and CMAMI and other nutrition-sensitive activities as and when needed and deputize Nutrition Supervisor.

**Report to:** Nutrition Supervisor (Nutritionist)

**Supervise to:** Community Nutrition Volunteers who will be assigned by your site.

**Job Descriptions / Responsibilities:**

Under the guidance of the Nutrition Supervisor, Deputy Program Manager and Program Manager (Nutritionist), the Community Nutrition Supervisor will be responsible for-

**Objective-1: Ensure effective implementation and timely completion of outreach activities.**

-   Mobilizing the Community Outreach teams to work with the target community to ensure that the project activities are delivered with maximum efficiency and professionalism.
    
-   Organizing the logistical arrangements for community level meetings with support from other project staff
    
-   Ensuring that the targeted community (under five, adolescent girls and pregnant and lactating women) are linked to the nutrition Centre for services e.g., Counselling, diagnosis, treatment.
    
-   Facilitating effective screening, listing and mobilization of the targeted community towards achieving objective
    
-   Facilitating effective screening at the community level among the targeted population
    
-   Ensuring that volunteers are adequately trained and are regularly supporting screening and refer the SAM, MAM and at-risk children.
    
-   Establish, train, and support Mother to Mother Support Groups (MtMSGs) and adolescent girl support groups.
    
-   Engaging the community members and motivating them to bring positive changes with the minimum resources towards achieving objective.
    
-   Ensuring that the nutrition mobilization plan is developed jointly with the team and delivered timely and effectively to ensure improvement in the nutrition status of the project participants beyond project end.
    
-   Regularly meet with, inform, and sensitize the local authorities, community leaders and members to ensure good understanding of the nutrition program. Anticipate possible community concerns and work proactively to address them.
    
-   Strategize and implement methods to ensure complete coverage of eligible beneficiaries within the assigned nutrition site catchment area.
    
-   Support the distribution of IFA to adolescent girls in the community, following CMAM protocols.
    
-   Support surveys and assessments in the assigned nutrition site catchment area.
    

**Objective-2: Ensure quality of program components at outreach level.**

-   Ensure high quality standards for measurement and other technical tasks carried out by Community Nutrition Volunteers, through assessment, training, and supportive supervision.
    
-   Ensure that each member of the outreach team fully understands the outcomes that are expected from them; supporting team members to work to the highest quality of standard possible.
    
-   Document internal and external monitoring findings, prepare action plan and share with Nutrition Supervisor, DPM and PM and execute that plan as per instruction.
    

**Objective-3: Ensure monitoring and timely reporting in place.**

-   Ensure sound monitoring of program activities and monitoring team at field level and share with line manager(s)
    
-   Collaborate with MEAL team to ensure timely compiling statistical data and draft appropriate reports on activities including producing monthly reports and end of program evaluation report.
    
-   Ensure documentations of lessons learnt and best practices within the implementation of the INI program.
    
-   Maintain databases and creating high quality reports, presentations, and other documents as required.
    

**Objective-4: Ensure staff supportive supervision and development, performance appraisal, update any vacancy and ensure vacancy fill up as required.**

-   Identify capacity gaps among component staffs/volunteers, prepare on the job capacity building and supportive supervision plan and provide initial and ongoing training to Community Nutrition Volunteers
    
-   Maintain open and professional relations with team members, promoting a strong team spirit and provide guidance to enable staff to successfully perform in their positions.
    
-   Monitor and review performance and holding staff accountable for meeting quality standards of work, delivering any improvement goals which have been identified, giving corrective feedback where required and taking decisive action when poor performance is identified.
    
-   Effectively manage leave of volunteers to meet HR compliance and run program efficiently and with quality.
    
-   Identify and update vacancy at outreach level to HR and line manager and Assist in the recruitment of Community Nutrition Volunteers
    

**Objective-5: Collaborate within team, Coordination and External Representation**

-   Act as a focal point for community leaders and members. Collect feedback and complaints and report back following CFRM guideline.
    
-   Attend CiC and other field level meetings as requested by the line managers.
    
-   Liaise with other partners providing nutrition and health activities in the nutrition site catchment area for good coordination of outreach activities.
    
-   Enable a friendly collaborative working culture within the team and conduct regular meetings with program staff to discuss and document lessons learned.
    

**Objective-6: Ensure organizational policies and donor compliances are in place.**

-   Orient team members on the Complaint Feedback Mechanism (CFM) and functional CFM at camp level following SoP
    
-   Be aware of, understand and comply with all of SHED\`s policies and procedures (P4, finance, logistics, HR, security management, PSEA, CoC, & Cross Cutting Issues etc.
    

**Besides, undertake other related duties as may reasonably be assigned by the line manager(s).**

### **Learning & Organizational Development**

### **HR Operations**

-   Continuously recommend innovative practices to improve employee engagement, productivity, and organizational effectiveness.

title: Senior officer, Emergency Preparedness and Response (EPR), HCMP
description:
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh in 1972 that partners globally with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty to create opportunities to realise their potential.

The **Emergency Preparedness and Response Officer** (EPRO) will lead camp-level contingency planning and implementation, collaborating with the Camp Manager and other camp actors. The EPRO will oversee the management, supervision, and training of the Site Management Support (SMS) Volunteers, ensuring that they are equipped with the necessary skills and tools to fulfill their duties. The EPRO will also conduct regular disaster risk assessments focusing on shelters, WASH installations, and other camp infrastructure. Additionally, the EPRO will be responsible for designing and implementing community-based disaster risk initiatives and exploring innovative interventions. This role requires advanced utilization of incident reporting tools such as MHIRT, VMT, and CAIPP, and will spearhead disaster risk management (DRM) measures across camp settings.

**MAJOR** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Development and Implementation of EPR Strategy:**

-   Take a leading role in developing and implementing an Emergency Preparedness and Response (EPR) strategy.
    
-   Collaborate with the SMS team, Camp in Charge (CiC), community members, and other camp actors to ensure a comprehensive approach.
    

**Contingency Planning and Implementation:**

-   Conduct contingency planning for natural disasters such as cyclones, flooding, landslides, and fires.
    
-   Use participatory methods to involve the community in planning processes.
    

-   Facilitate standard process and quality implementation of various projects/schemes and timely reporting.
    

-   Necessary logistical arrangement and management of stock and record keeping.
    

**Disaster Risk Vulnerability Mapping:**

-   Perform disaster risk vulnerability mapping in camps managed by BRAC.
    
-   Share findings with relevant sector leads.
    
-   Provide advice on preparedness actions based on vulnerability assessments.
    

**Coordination of Disaster Drills:**

-   Organize and coordinate regular disaster drills at the camp level.
    
-   Work in coordination with the fire department, Cyclone Preparedness Programme (CPP), and the CiC.
    
-   Necessary coordination and collaboration with different partners working in the camp.
    

**Volunteer Management:**

-   Maintain updated lists of all volunteer groups in the camp.
    
-   Ensure volunteer groups are prepared to respond during disasters.
    
-   Support any emergency response and lead the team to reduce the negative impact.
    
-   Facilitate management of mobile firefighting units (MFFU) and necessary guidance to the volunteers for its 24/7 functioning.
    

**Capacity Building and Training:**

-   Conduct capacity building and training sessions for various partners on EPR.
    
-   Develop and implement strategies to enhance staff and volunteer’s capabilities in disaster preparedness and response.
    
-   Organize and facilitate various events including meetings, training workshops and reporting.
    
-   Manage and train Site Management Volunteers and Volunteer Block Leaders.
    
-   Ensure SMS volunteers are equipped with the necessary tools and equipment’s to perform their duties effectively.
    

**Representation and Coordination:**

-   Attend and represent BRAC in sectoral coordination meetings at both Cox’s Bazar and camp levels.
    
-   Ensure effective communication and coordination with all stakeholders.
    

**Reporting and Organizational Learning:**

-   Produce periodic reports on DRR activities and outcomes.
    
-   Contribute to BRAC’s organizational learning by sharing insights and best practices from field experiences.
    
-   Participate in DMC meetings and any other ad hoc meetings, take notes, and produce high quality meeting minutes and forward them to Camp Managers for final editing and dissemination
    
-   Ensure a monitoring and evaluation system is developed to include indicators, tools, and methods of data collection and analysis as well as frequency of data collection.
    
-   Ensure updated service mapping, site profiles and any other rapid assessments as may be required.
    
-   To lead enumerators/volunteers or project assistants during data collection including for surveys, needs assessments, service gap analysis, or any other relevant processes.
    
-   Maintain Trackers, identifying existing gaps, ways and tools of information gathering, data entry, storage, and data analysis techniques.
    
-   Ensuring VMT submission from volunteers, and update and track volunteer related database and trackers.
    

**Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP):**

-   Ensure all Emergency Preparedness and Response (EPR) activities are inclusive, addressing the needs and voices of vulnerable groups within the community.
    
-   Design and implement feedback and response mechanisms, allowing camp residents to report needs, concerns, and issues regarding safety and EPR measures.
    
-   Facilitate community awareness sessions to keep the camp population informed of EPR activities, anticipated risks, and response actions, enhancing transparency and trust.
    
-   Work closely with community leaders and volunteers to integrate feedback from affected populations into EPR planning and adjustments.
    

**Anticipatory Action:**

-   Facilitate E**arly Warning Systems** in coordination with Camp Administration, the Cyclone Preparedness Programme (CPP) Camp Focal Relevant Partners, and Camp Management.
    
-   Conduct **scenario planning and simulation exercises** for likely hazards, such as cyclones, fires, landslides, and floods, to assess and improve response capabilities.
    
-   Establish pre-positioned supplies and conduct readiness assessments for rapid deployment of resources and teams.
    
-   Ensure that anticipatory actions, such as household relocations and strengthening of critical infrastructure, are initiated based on hazard forecasts.
    

**Emergency Response Planning:**

-   Develop a **comprehensive Emergency Response Plan** tailored to the primary hazards in camps, including **fire, cyclone, landslide, and flood risks**.
    
-   Implement **fire safety protocols**, including mobile firefighting units (MFFU) training, evacuation planning, and fire risk awareness for camp residents.
    
-   Coordinate with relevant actors, including the camp administration, community, volunteers, and humanitarian partners, during all emergency situations.
    
-   Establish **designated safe zones** and **emergency shelters** for cyclone and flood evacuation.
    
-   Map landslide-prone areas, and initiate **slope stabilization measures** and **early warning systems**.
    
-   Prepare and maintain an **inventory of emergency supplies**, ensuring materials are on hand for immediate response to post-disaster.
    
-   Regularly update the Emergency Response Plan in consultation with camp residents, CiC, and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment with local and national DRM protocols.
    

**Safeguarding:**

-   Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme's goals of safeguarding implementation.
    
-   Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
    
-   Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action. 
    
-   Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so.

title: Lab Technologist
description:
**Job Summary**

The **Lab Technologist** at **Ad-Din Medical Center – Ukhiya** is responsible for performing laboratory investigations accurately and efficiently to support patient diagnosis, treatment, and disease prevention. The incumbent will ensure high standards of laboratory practice by maintaining quality assurance protocols, operating and maintaining laboratory equipment, handling patient specimens safely, and adhering to infection prevention and biosafety guidelines. The role requires strong technical competence, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering timely, reliable, and high-quality diagnostic services while upholding professional ethics and patient confidentiality.

**Key Responsibilities**

-   Perform routine and specialized laboratory tests in Hematology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Serology, Immunology, and Clinical Pathology according to established laboratory protocols.
    
-   Collect, receive, label, process, and preserve patient specimens accurately while ensuring proper identification and handling procedures.
    
-   Operate, calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain laboratory instruments and equipment to ensure optimal performance.
    
-   Analyze laboratory test results, verify their accuracy, and report findings promptly to the concerned physicians.
    
-   Implement and maintain internal and external quality control measures to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of laboratory results.
    
-   Maintain accurate laboratory records, registers, and documentation in compliance with hospital policies and regulatory standards.
    
-   Ensure compliance with infection prevention, biosafety, waste management, and occupational health and safety guidelines.
    
-   Monitor laboratory inventory and coordinate the procurement of reagents, consumables, and other laboratory supplies to ensure uninterrupted services.
    
-   Collaborate effectively with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to facilitate quality patient care and timely clinical decision-making.
    
-   Maintain strict confidentiality of patient information and laboratory records in accordance with ethical and legal requirements.
    
-   Participate in laboratory quality improvement initiatives, audits, accreditation activities, and continuing professional development programs.
    
-   Stay updated with advancements in laboratory technology, diagnostic procedures, and best practices to enhance service quality.
    
-   Perform any other laboratory-related duties assigned by the Laboratory In-charge or Hospital Management.

-   ব্র্যান্ডিং বজায় রাখা: সব ওয়েব পেজ এবং ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে কোম্পানির ব্র্যান্ড গাইডলাইন নিখুঁতভাবে বজায় রাখা।
-   মিডিয়া অপটিমাইজেশন: ওয়েবসাইটের স্পিড বাড়ানোর জন্য ছবি ও ভিডিওর সাইজ কম্প্রেস (ছোট) এবং অপটিমাইজ করা।

**ওয়েব মেইনটেন্যান্স ও সাইট ব্যবস্থাপনা (Web Maintenance & Site Administration)**

**কোলাবোরেশন ও স্ট্র্যাটেজি (Strategy & Collaboration)**

-   মার্কেটিং টিমের সাথে কাজ: বিভিন্ন ক্যাম্পেইনের জন্য মার্কেটিং টিমের সাথে সমন্বয় করে ডিজাইন তৈরি করা।
-   ডেভেলপারদের সাথে যোগাযোগ: ওয়েবসাইটের বড় ধরনের কোনো ব্যাকএন্ড বা কোডিং সমস্যা হলে ডেভেলপার টিমের সাথে যোগাযোগ করে তা সমাধান করা।

title: Manager, Employee Onboarding and Early Careers, LLD
description:
BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential. Working at BRAC is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world; we are building it. Join us to find the way.

We\`re looking for someone to lead the future of onboarding and early career development at BRAC. You\`ll design engaging onboarding experiences that help employees integrate seamlessly, build capability, and thrive from day one. From shaping onboarding for mid-to-senior-level hires to developing first-time managers and leading returnship programmes for women professionals, you\`ll play a key role in strengthening our people, culture, and long-term success.

If you\`re passionate about creating impactful learning experiences, developing future leaders, and shaping meaningful employee journeys, take the next step and join the Learning and Leadership Development (LLD) team at BRAC.

**Key Responsibilities:**

-   Design, implement, and continuously improve structured onboarding journeys for mid-to-senior-level employees to ensure effective integration into the organization.

-   Design, coordinate, and execute learning and development programs for first-time managers, including curriculum development, content creation, facilitation, and program administration.
    
-   Lead the planning and implementation of returnship and career re-entry programs for women professionals to strengthen the organization\`s mid-career leadership pipeline.
    
-   Coordinate with HR Business Partners and relevant support functions to ensure effective planning, execution, and monitoring of onboarding and leadership development initiatives.
    
-   Prepare periodic reports and analyze program outcomes, participant feedback, and learning effectiveness to support continuous improvement.
    
-   Monitor and evaluate onboarding frameworks, learning journeys, and leadership development modules, incorporating feedback and data-driven insights to enhance program quality and impact.
    
-   Develop and manage annual budgets, resource planning, vendor coordination, and operational activities related to the onboarding and learning function.
    
-   Facilitate assigned learning programs, Training of Trainers (ToT) sessions, workshops, and other organizational capacity-building initiatives.
    
-   Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Employer Branding, Internal Communications, and cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver employee engagement and organizational culture initiatives.
    

**Safeguarding Responsibilities:**

-   Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation, and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance, and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.

**Job Context**

**SAINT-Bangladesh** is a value based independent, non-profit and Non-Government Organization (NGO), participating in survival strategies of coastal poor. It believes in integration of right based approach in striving for people centered sustainable development initiatives, maintaining a level of transparency, participation, accountability, child and gender sensitivity and respect to human rights and dignity principles in management. SAINT-Bangladesh is seeking a professional for the position of Union Facilitator (Education) for the project titled "Integrated Child Development Project-Shishuder Jonno (ICDP)" funded by Save the Children International and the project will be implemented in Barishal district from March 2019. Note that this requirement will depend on the availability of donor fund.

**OVERVIEW OF THE PROJECT:**

Shishuder Jonno' (For the children) Program is a sponsorship funded initiative of Save the Children in Bangladesh to support development of children particularly who are deprived from basic needs and services like health, education and living opportunities. Under this program, comprehensive activities as appropriate to children below 19 years are in implementation through following life-cycle approach. Country Office has been implementing diversified program core components, such as Maternal, Newborn, Child Health & Nutrition (MNCHN), Early Childhood Care & Development (ECCD) including Early Childhood Care and Stimulation (ECCSP), Basic Education (BE) including ICT in education, School Health & Nutrition (SHN) & Adolescent Development (AD). The non-core components are - Child Protection (CP) and Child Rights & Governance (CRG). The cross-cutting components are - Community Mobilization, Social Safety net, Gender and Inclusion.

-   This Integrated Child Development Program has been engaging children, their families and community actors in order to address the needs of the children and to create enabling development environment for them. Save the Children have been continuing sponsorship interventions in its Rural Impact Area (IA) of Bakergonj & Muladi Upazila in Barishal District to implement long-term, age appropriate, children development program for next 10 years.
    

**Job Location:** Bakergonj / Muladi Upazila in Barishal District

**Job Responsibilities**

-   The Field Facilitator (ECCD & BE) is the font line staff of ICDP-SJ program for implementing ECCD & Basic Education program effectively at the community and primary school/Ebtedayee Madrasha level.
    
-   S/he will also responsible to ensure mobilizing community through participatory approach; closely work with parents, SMC, PTA, Community Group, Community Support Group, Primary School Teachers, Union Parishad, community leaders, local elites, and ensure effective participation/engagement of them, building their capacity for sustaining impact& building ownership on program.
    
-   S/he will ensure high standard of service for children, parents and for community in collaboration with other program/component of ICDD-SJ (School Health & Nutrition, Child Protection, and Child Right & Governance & Community Mobilization) and other service provider at community level.
    
-   This is a union based position.

title: Market Linkage Facilitator (Tailoring, Dressmaking and Handicraft Value Chain)
skills: B2B and B2C sales and marketing
description:
Young Power in Social Action (YPSA) <www.ypsa.org>, established in 1985 (International Youth Year) is an organization for sustainable development working in Dhaka Division, Sylhet Division, Chattogram Division including Chittagong Hill Tracts, Cox’s Bazar and Bhasan Char. Currently, YPSA is working with a total of 15 million (estimated) disadvantaged and vulnerable people. YPSA has been implementing a project titled “Multi-sector Recovery and Empowerment Support for crises affected communities in Cox’s Bazar Activity.” since 2020. The project is technical supported by International Rescue Committee (IRC) and funded by US DoS.

Job Title: Market Linkage Facilitator (Tailoring, Dressmaking and Handicraft Value Chain)

No. of Positions: 2

Duration: 3 Months or 60 Days (Possibility to extend based on project’s need)

Job location: Cox’s Bazar (Chakaria, Ramu and Ukhiya)

Objectives & Context:

Vulnerable women and youth are being supported through the Economic and Social Empowerment (EA$E) program approach to recover and strengthen income generation activities through non-firm activities i.e. handicrafts, tailoring and Dreas making, pottery business etc. in Ukhiya, Chakariya, and Ramu Upazila of Cox’s Bazar. Despite strong potential, women and youth face constraints in technical skills, designing, finishing, quality assurance and access to structured markets. The YPSA has been facilitating the interventions combining hands-on and market-oriented training, business recovery support with market linkage support to address the gaps of skills in designing, cutting, stitching, embroidery, handicraft production, finishing, and product diversification, alongside business competencies such as costing, pricing and marketing. Engagement with buyers, inputs suppliers, and connecting with digital platforms for specific products will enhance product quality, market readiness and income opportunities for the women producers.

A Market Linkage Facilitator will be connecting producers with buyers, facilitating order generation, coordinating production planning, and ensuring efficient flow from order to delivery and payment. The role will also support engagement of the producers with buyers and suppliers to ensure product quality, innovation, and access to appropriate raw materials. In addition, the facilitator will facilitate to form women led producer groups to enable collective production, bulk order management, and price negotiation capacity within the market systems. Through integrated skills development, entrepreneurship promotion, and market facilitation, the women producers will be able to recover and enhance their income generation activities and increase market participation of vulnerable women in Cox’s bazar.

**Key Responsibilities:**

-   Assess products, skills and capacity of the women producers
    
-   Identify and engage buyers; facilitate B2B interactions and negotiate orders following the product, skills and capacity of the producers
    
-   Capture and record order details (product type, specifications, sample collection, quantity, price, and delivery schedule)
    
-   Translate orders into production plans, including costing, materials, and timelines
    
-   Form and coordinate producer groups based on skills and capacity
    
-   Allocate tasks across production stages (cutting, stitching, finishing, quality control)
    
-   Track production progress to ensure adherence to targets and deadlines
    
-   Develop designer/cutting masters for design refinement, pattern development, and precision cutting
    
-   Manage sample development, approval processes, and alignment with final outputs
    
-   Arrange timely and cost-efficient sourcing of fabrics and accessories through reliable suppliers
    
-   Supervise finishing, packaging, and delivery while resolving production or quality issues
    
-   Facilitate clear payment arrangements and ensure timely transactions
    
-   Attend fairs by coordination with Livelihoods and Skill Development Sectors (LSDs) in Cox’s Bazar
    
-   Maintain systematic records of buyers, orders, production status, and payments; provide regular reports,
    
-   Prepare progress reports, lessons learned, and success stories.
    
-   **Deliverables**
    
-   No. of product businesses established
    
-   No. of producers and buyers identified and engaged
    
-   Orders generated and documented (type, quantity, value)
    
-   No. of samples developed and approved
    
-   No. of orders produced and delivered on time
    
-   Target vs achievement against production and sales

title: Medical Support Executive
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Noora Health Bangladesh is part of Noora Health’s broader mission to improve health outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with essential skills to care for their loved ones.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Medical Support Executive will play a key role in supporting patients and caregivers through Noora Health\`s Remote Engagement Service (RES), a digital platform designed to provide timely, reliable health information and guidance. This position involves responding to health-related queries, ensuring high-quality communication, escalating critical cases when needed to Medical Officers, and helping strengthen the overall user experience. The ideal candidate is a healthcare professional with strong clinical knowledge, excellent communication skills in Bangla and English, and a passion for leveraging digital tools to improve health outcomes at scale.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

We are seeking an experienced healthcare professional with strong medical knowledge and excellent communication skills to respond to user questions through our Remote Engagement Service (RES) platform. RES is a mobile-based messaging service that supports patients and caregivers with trusted health information and guidance. You will play a key role in strengthening and scaling the service across Bangladesh.

**Respond to patient and caregiver questions on our digital platform**

-   Respond to health-related questions received through the RES platform (WhatsApp, phone-based services, or other digital channels) in 16/7 roster
    
-   Support Maternal and Child Health, Non-Communicable Diseases, General, Medicine, General Surgery, ANC, PNC and SCANU content areas
    
-   Review and edit AI generated responses to ensure medical accuracy, completeness and empathy before responding
    
-   Escalate urgent or high-priority cases according to established triaging protocols.
    
-   Coordinate with technical and Engineering teams to report and resolve technical issues.
    

**Support the development of the RES two-way response system**

-   Support in developing a knowledge base of questions and answers, and training of AI
    
-   Conduct user calls to understand needs and behaviours and collect feedback
    
-   Maintain and share data and reports on the RES two-way response system
    
-   Identify challenges in the response system and develop the mitigation plan
    
-   Collaborate and cooperate with other teams to improve the service Perform other need-based tasks
    
-   Participate in capacity building programs
    

**WORKING DETAILS:**

-   **Working Days:** 5 days per week
    
-   **Working Hours:** Roster-based (includes day and night shifts)
    
-   **Weekends:** Any 2 days (based on roster)
    
-   **Roster Cycle:** Weekly
    
-   **Working Mode:** Hybrid (Remote + Office)

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Samaj Kalyan O Unnayan Shangstha (SKUS) envisions a peaceful, prosperous, and poverty-free society that ensures everyone\`s basic needs and rights. SKUS has since the 2017 Rohingya refugee influx worked in Cox\`s Bazar district with children and adolescents. SKUS works to provide access to learning opportunities in a safe and protective environment, offer quality teaching/learning and increase refugee/host community participation and engagement in children\`s education. Based on children’s and adolescents’ rights, SKUS has established quality learning and protection centers with support from different international donors, including UN agencies.  SKUS will implement SBF project with technical support from Plan International Bangladesh for Rohingya communities at Rohingya Camps, at Ukhia and Teknaf Upazila under Cox\`s Bazar District.  The aim of this project is to advance the quality education for Rohniya children in all their diversity in Cox’s Bazar Rohingya refugee camps.

**Purpose of the job:**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for the overall management of the project in compliance with the SKUS policies and procedures. S/he will be overall responsible for the delivery of commitments, reporting and managing resources (HR, Monetary, physical asset) and relation with local administration. S/He will support project staff and take initiatives to build their capacity for effective implementation of project activities. S/He will closely work and maintain effective coordination with Technical Officers, Admin and Logistics Officer, Finance Officer, M&E Officer of the Project. S/he will also work closely with other component team members of the project, other project teams, stakeholders, relevant government officials, private sector, non-government, and civil society organizations. S/He will also ensure project implementation meets the global/organizational standards of emergency responses and donors’ compliance aspects; ensure project monitoring mechanism is established and functional to ensure quality implementation and downwards accountability.

**Duration of contract:** Up to May 31, 2028, and contingent on donor extension and government approval.

**Key Responsibilities:**

-   Oversee project implementation in line with agreements, budget, and plans.
    
-   Manage risks, documentation, and escalate challenges to Plan International Bangladesh.
    
-   Represent SKUS with donors and agencies at Ukhiya/Teknaf/Cox’s Bazar.
    
-   Support and guide project staff.
    
-   Lead activities to achieve project outcomes.
    
-   Prepare and share progress and analytical reports.
    
-   Facilitate required GoB approvals with Plan International Bangladesh.
    
-   Lead project interventions focused on Education in Emergencies (ECD, MC, ALP, PSCD) for Rohingya and host communities.
    
-   Ensure compliance with Plan/SBT standards, humanitarian principles, safeguarding, accountability, and donor visibility.
    
-   Develop and monitor DIP with Plan International & SKUS senior management.
    
-   Manage budget and ensure timely, quality delivery of activities with satisfactory expenditure.
    
-   Coordinate with HR, Finance, Admin, and Logistics for resources and smooth operations.
    
-   Support development/review of guidelines/manuals for partner operations.
    
-   Ensure quality documentation, evidence generation, case studies, and learning products in collaboration with project and technical teams.
    
-   Hold regular review and coordination meetings with project team.
    
-   Support timely, quality program delivery and build staff capacity.
    
-   Organize meetings, trainings, and workshops with government and stakeholders; maintain coordination with CiCs, local administration, and sector platforms.
    
-   Provide technical support for purchase orders, record-keeping, and tracking with relevant departments.
    
-   Facilitate internal communication with HR, Finance, and support services for smooth operations.
    
-   Ensure adoption of Safeguarding and PSEA policies and promote gender equality with partners.
    
-   Support development of training materials and tools for inclusive, gender-responsive education programs.
    
-   Initiate staff capacity building through needs assessments and facilitate training sessions with technical team support.
    
-   Follow guidance from Programme Specialist and technical team on quality inputs, monitoring, expenditure, and donor compliance.
    
-   Build and maintain relationships with district/Upazila officials and CICs.
    
-   Attend coordination meetings at camps and UNO office.
    
-   Support regular reviews of project progress, challenges, and learning for adaptive implementation.
    
-   Create and support inclusive, gender-responsive education training programs and tools.
    
-   Drive staff capacity building by assessing needs and facilitating training sessions with technical teams.
    

-   Supervise and monitor project activities, providing essential support through the use of designated tools and a monitoring framework.
    

-   Develop and implement robust methods for measuring impact and results, ensuring alignment with reporting obligations.
    
-   Orient staff on project monitoring tools and guidelines, ensuring their proficient application in data collection.
    
-   Generate punctual monthly/quarterly financial and narrative reports (including FD7), adhering to Plan, donor, and government requirements, with assistance from the M&E Officer.
    
-    Drive the early and rigorous implementation of quality and accountability mechanisms, supporting regular progress reviews and adaptive learning.
    
-   Capture and document best practices and success stories, promoting opportunities for shared learning across teams.
    
-   Collaborate with Project Focal Points to guarantee the timely submission of high-quality reports.
    
-   Upholds humanitarian principles: humanity, neutrality, impartiality, independence, do no harm
    
-   Respects diversity, inclusion, and individual/cultural differences
    
-   Maintains integrity, transparency, and high ethical standards
    
-   Professional, results-driven, and collaborative team player
    
-   Accountable, communicative, and committed to continuous learning
    
-   Adheres to SKUS\`s Code of Conduct, Safegurading, PSEA, Child Protection, and Gender policies
    
-   Promotes equal opportunity regardless of gender, religion, race, nationality, or age.

title: Technical Support Executive
description:
Behind every smooth workday at Eicra Soft Limited is a Technical Support Executive quietly making sure systems, networks, and devices never miss a beat. This role sits at the frontline of our IT-enabled services and MSP operations, acting as the trusted go-to person whenever a hardware glitch, network hiccup, or software issue threatens to slow the team down. It is a role built for someone who takes genuine pride in solving problems fast, keeping people productive, and continuously raising the bar on how support gets delivered.[jobss.pdf](jobss.pdf)

-   **First point of contact:** Respond promptly to IT support requests from employees and clients, resolving day-to-day technical issues with speed and professionalism.
    
-   **Hardware & device support:** Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, and other office IT equipment.
    
-   **Network reliability:** Maintain and monitor LAN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and network devices to keep operations running without interruption.
    
-   **Systems & software management:** Install and update operating systems, antivirus software, and core business applications across the organization.
    
-   **Infrastructure monitoring:** Continuously monitor IT systems and infrastructure health, catching and resolving issues before they escalate.
    
-   **Vendor coordination:** Liaise with external vendors and service providers to ensure timely maintenance, repairs, and technical support.
    
-   **Onboarding & offboarding support:** Assist with account setup and system access as employees join or leave the organization.
    
-   **Documentation & process improvement:** Spot recurring issues and contribute to internal guides and self-service resources that reduce repeat problems.
    
-   **Team collaboration:** Escalate complex or high-impact issues to senior technical staff and work cross-functionally to resolve them efficiently.
    
-   **Additional responsibilities:** Take on other technical or operational tasks as assigned by management, with growing exposure to more advanced systems over time.
    

This is more than a support desk job — it is an opportunity to become the backbone of technical reliability at a company built on 16+ years of trust and service excellence. If you thrive on solving problems, love keeping systems running seamlessly, and want a role where your contributions are felt across the entire organization, this is the place to grow your career.

title: Asst. Manager / Sr. Executive- Fabric Technologist and R&D
description:
**Job Context:** AKH Knitting & Dyeing is a 100% export oriented knit composite factory. We are looking for a experienced Assistant Manager / Sr. Executive - fabric technologist and R & D who support the development, innovation, and commercialization of knitted fabrics by coordinating fabric research, new product development, laboratory evaluation, process optimization, and customer requirement analysis. The position is responsible for ensuring that developed fabrics meet quality, performance, cost, and sustainability requirements while supporting business growth and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities:**

-   Develop new knitted fabric qualities according to buyer requirements and market trends.
-   Conduct research on fiber, yarn, knitting, dyeing, finishing, and garment performance.
-   Evaluate innovative raw materials, specialty fibers, and sustainable fabric solutions.
-   Prepare fabric development plans and timelines for new projects.
-   Work closely with merchandising and marketing teams to convert customer inquiries into commercial products.
-   Conduct trials for new fabric constructions, blends, and finishing techniques.
-   Analyze test results and recommend process improvements.
-   Maintain records of development projects, trial reports, and technical findings.
-   Benchmark competitor products and market innovations.
-   Support continuous improvement initiatives within the factory.
-   Analyze fabric specifications, technical data sheets, and customer requirements.
-   Calculate GSM, stitch density, shrinkage, width utilization, and fabric yield.
-   Ensure developed fabrics meet required physical and chemical performance standards.
-   Troubleshoot fabric quality issues and provide technical solutions.
-   Coordinate with Knitting, Dyeing, Finishing, Quality, and Production teams.
-   Monitor pilot and bulk production performance of newly developed fabrics.
-   Coordinate fabric testing activities in accordance with AATCC, ASTM, ISO, and buyer standards.
-   Review laboratory test reports and approve development samples.
-   Ensure compliance with color fastness, shrinkage, pilling, spirality, dimensional stability, and other performance standards.
-   Support root cause analysis of laboratory and production failures.
-   Communicate with buyers regarding development requirements and technical issues.
-   Promote sustainable materials and environmentally friendly processes.
-   Maintain development trackers and technical databases.
-   Prepare weekly and monthly R&D reports.
-   Document lessons learned and technical standards for future developments.
-   Ensure confidentiality of proprietary developments and customer information.

title: Health Promoter Community Engagement Supervisor (HPCE Supervisor)

company.name: Medecins Sans Frontieres/ Doctors Without Borders (MSF)

description:
**Accountabilities:**

-   Actively contribute to the design/adaptation of the HPCE strategy / workplan.
-   Lead and follow up on the implementation of the HPCE strategy / workplan, according to the chronogram.
-   Support participatory approaches and regular patient/community consultations before and during implementation of the HPCE strategy.
-   Organizing health awareness sessions for MSF's medical and non-medical staff
-   Support in the design of health education materials and participatory methods, applying the right process
-   (pretesting, validation of content, translation).
-   Contribute to rapid assessments and surveys.
-   Actively support in the systematic collection, encoding and reporting of community feedback and rumours.
-   Support the implementation of community-based surveillance (data collection, active case finding, tracing, linkage to care.
-   Responsible for the planning and organization of community meetings (in collaboration with HPCE Manager).
-   Contribute to the community mapping.
-   Monitoring: Ensure the availability of the data collection tools; the data encoding in the database and the quality check.
-   Monitoring: Contribute to the analysis of the monitoring data and look for adjustment (in collaboration with HPCE manager), monthly reporting (MMR, sitrep).
-   Team management:
-   Contribute to evaluations of the HPCE team (with the HPCE manager).
-   Contribute to the development plan for the HPCE team.
-   Training: Contribute to the needs assessment, design and implementation of training for the HPCE team, in collaboration with the HPCE manager.
-   Organize regular and systematic supervision of the HP activities and provide on the job-coaching.
-   Ensure the planning and practical organization of the activities for the HP team (HP roster).
-   Ensure the organization of regular HPCE team meetings.

**MSF Section/Context Specific Accountabilities**

-   Implement the HPCE strategy including integrating any new components.
-   Assist in defining and developing engagement narratives and materials.
-   Create guidelines and tools to support HPCE activities.
-   Ensure a smooth collaboration with other departments, particularly medical and logistics departments, to achieve the project’s objectives.
-   Contribute to the development and maintenance of a network of key community people and actors in HOH’s catchment area, with the PC Support, through participation in community engagement activities, actors mapping, etc.
-   Assist the medical team in assessing patient support needs.
-   Help the medico-operational team to understand the context and health cultural practices and beliefs through supporting the organization and implementation of qualitative and/or quantitative assessments within the community or health facility, as required.
-   Support HPCE teams to collect accurate data, and prepare the monthly report and analysis (sitrep) in collaboration with the HPCE Manager.
-   Contribute to identifying the monthly priorities for the HPCE department with the HPCE Manager.
-   Alongside the HPCE Manager, participate in different meetings with other OCs for experience sharing and intersectional collaboration.
-   Ensure prompt communication to the medical team on any unusual epidemiological situation in the camps.
-   Collaborate with the Ops team on the security/risk analysis of the catchment area.
-   Directly supervise the HCHW, give them the required support (monitoring, training, orientation, etc.) and carry out their BILAN.
-   Plan the monthly roster of the HP team (HCHW, CHPV, TBA) and make the meal contribution sheet.
-   Organize and plan the team’s leave with the HR team and manage any day-to-day absences.
-   Assess the needs of the HP team in terms of materials and equipment for the smooth running of health promotion activities with the support of the HCHW. Make the monthly IR according to these needs.
-   Ensure continuous monitoring of the activities with the support of the HCHWs through regular field visits.
-   Identify and communicate any HR issues within the team and suggest potential solutions.
-   Plan the blood donation campaign in close collaboration with the laboratory and focal points
-   Ensure the compliance of the MSF processes by the HP team, in collaboration with the HPCE Manager
-   Ensure the quality and the participative approach of the HPCE activities (awareness sessions, home visits, patient follow up, community orientation, etc.)
-   Report issues, complaints, questions to the line manager

title: Senior Executive - Accounts And Finance
description:
## Job Description: Executive Accountant – Steel Manufacturing

## Job Summary

The Executive Accountant will manage daily accounting activities, Tally entries, manufacturing costing, bank reconciliation, taxation, audit documentation, and management reporting. The candidate should understand steel manufacturing or other process-based manufacturing accounts.

## Key Responsibilities

### Tally Accounting and Daily Entries

-   Record daily transactions accurately in **Tally ERP/Prime**.
-   Prepare purchase, payment, receipt, journal, contra, debit note, and credit note vouchers.
-   Maintain supplier, customer, bank, loan, expense, and advance ledgers.
-   Ensure every entry has proper approval and supporting documents.
-   Identify and correct incorrect, duplicate, or misclassified entries.

### Manufacturing Cost Accounting

-   Calculate the production cost of billets, rebars, rods, and other steel products.
-   Prepare cost sheets covering:
    -   Scrap and raw materials
    -   Ferroalloys and chemicals
    -   Electricity and fuel
    -   Refractory and consumable materials
    -   Labour
    -   Repair and maintenance
    -   Factory overheads
    -   Transportation and conversion costs
-   Calculate production cost per metric ton and per kilogram.
-   Compare actual costs with budgeted or standard costs.
-   Identify unusual cost increases and report them to management.
-   Analyse yield, wastage, burning loss, cutting loss, and production recovery.

### Production Reconciliation

-   Reconcile daily and monthly production reports with accounting records.
-   Review scrap consumption, billet production, billet rolling, and finished goods output.
-   Calculate production yield, recovery percentage, and manufacturing loss.
-   Investigate abnormal wastage, production differences, and cost variations.
-   Prepare heat-wise, shift-wise, or product-wise costing when required.

### Purchase and Supplier Accounting

-   Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders, goods received records, weighbridge slips, and approved rates.
-   Check quantity, price, VAT, tax, transport, and other charges.
-   Maintain supplier ledgers and reconciliation statements.
-   Monitor supplier advances, outstanding balances, and payment schedules.
-   Prevent duplicate, unsupported, or incorrect payments.

### Bank Reconciliation and Banking Activities

-   Prepare regular bank reconciliation statements.
-   Resolve differences between bank statements and Tally records.
-   Record bank charges, interest, loan instalments, LC payments, and other transactions.
-   Maintain cheque, online transfer, deposit, and dishonoured cheque records.
-   Assist management with loan, working capital, cash credit, and banking documentation.

### Cost Control and Internal Controls

-   Monitor manufacturing expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities.
-   Review wastage, repair expenses, overtime, fuel usage, and emergency purchases.
-   Compare current purchase prices with previous rates and approved quotations.
-   Verify expense claims and payment approvals.
-   Help prevent fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorised expenses, and financial leakage.
-   Report unusual transactions or unexplained cost variations to management.

### Financial and Management Reporting

-   Assist in preparing:
    -   Trial balance
    -   Profit and loss statement
    -   Balance sheet
    -   Cash-flow statement
    -   Cost-of-production statement
    -   Payables and receivables reports
    -   Bank and loan position
    -   Budget-versus-actual report
    -   Product profitability report
-   Prepare monthly reports on production costs, expenses, wastage, and profitability.
-   Submit accurate reports within management deadlines.

### Budgeting and Cash-Flow Monitoring

-   Assist in preparing monthly and annual budgets.
-   Prepare cash-flow forecasts.
-   Monitor expected collections, supplier payments, loan instalments, utility bills, and statutory payments.
-   Inform management about upcoming payment obligations or cash shortages.
-   Compare actual expenses with budgeted expenses and explain major differences.

### Audit and Documentation

-   Maintain organised vouchers, invoices, challans, contracts, bank documents, and accounting records.
-   Assist internal and external auditors.
-   Prepare ledger schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents.
-   Respond to audit observations and help implement corrective actions.
-   Maintain confidentiality of financial and commercial information.

### Additional Responsibilities

-   Perform any other accounting, financial, commercial, administrative, or operational duties assigned by management.
-   Support special audits, costing exercises, investigations, and management assignments.
-   Work at the factory, head office, bank, or other company locations when require

title: Research Officer
description:
**Project-specific Responsibilities:**

-   Contribute to the development of recommendations for more inclusive disaster resilience strategies for vulnerable populations.
-   Collaborate with field teams to support data collection and ensure proper implementation of research methods.
-   Provide technical support and guidance to team members on data management and research protocols.

**Safeguarding Responsibilities:**

-   Adhere to CDD's Children and Adults at Risk Safeguarding policy, ensuring the safety and well-being of all project participants.
-   Promote a safe and secure environment for all participants and stakeholders of the project.
-   Report any safeguarding concerns promptly and follow the designated reporting procedures.

**Additional Responsibilities:**

-   Perform any other responsibility/ special duty delegated by project and CDD management.

**Job Context:**

-   The Centre for Disability in Development (CDD) is a non-profit organization established in 1996 to develop a more inclusive society for persons with disabilities. CDD simultaneously builds technical capacities of the development stakeholders and the communities in how to be more inclusive whilst also enabling persons with a disability to participate in society by strengthening their leadership and providing them with essential rehabilitation and other supports.
-   CDD is one of the most renowned organizations in the field of disability-inclusive development. CDD’s work in Bangladesh is supported by international and national donor agencies/development partners. CDD offers an inclusive, amicable, and respectable work environment.
-   The Ramon Magsaysay Award (Asian version of the Noble prize) has been awarded to its former Executive Director in 2010. In 2018, CDD was recognized by the Government of Bangladesh as one of the best organizations working on disability and development issues.
-   CDD is accepting application for the position of ‘Research Officer’ under a project title ‘Resilience Begins at Home: Disability-Inclusive Disaster Preparedness in Coastal Bangladesh’ to be implemented with the supported by the Liliane Fonds. Key responsibilities include reviewing relevant project activities, measuring project result, Monitoring, mapping available services, overseeing data collection processes (including the use of KOBO Toolbox), ensuring data accuracy and quality, and analyzing and presenting research findings in reports that contribute to policy development. The position requires strong knowledge of disaster management, climate change, and disability inclusion, along with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders to foster inclusive and resilient communities. Demonstrated leadership, solid technical skills, and strategic thinking are essential for this role.
-   The duration of the project is till 31st July 2027. The selected candidate will initially be hired for a three-month probationary period. Upon successful completion of this period, his/her employment contract will be renewed on an annual basis.

description:
Operations & Process Optimization

​SOP Implementation:

​Quality Control & Compliance

-   ​Quality Assurance: Partner with Quality Control (QC) teams to enforce defect-prevention measures, ensuring every unit meets customer specifications and internal standards.
-   Compliance: Maintain a safe, compliant, and ergonomic work environment in accordance with industry safety standards and labor regulations.
-   Workforce Leadership & Team Management

Manpower Planning:

Team Development:

title: Finance and Accounts Specialist
description:
**About PalmPay**

PalmPay is a leading neobank and fintech platform scaling financial inclusion across emerging markets. With over 40 million users, we are building a digital financial ecosystem that empowers individuals and businesses through accessible, easy-to-use, and rewarding financial services.

Operating in Nigeria, Ghana, Tanzania, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and the Philippines, PalmPay has been recognized by CNBC as one of the Top 300 Global Fintech Companies and ranked #2 overall and #1 in financial services on the Financial Times' Africa's Fastest Growing Companies 2025 list.

**Position Overview**

PalmPay is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented **Finance & Accounts Specialist** to join its Finance & Accounts team in Bangladesh. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day accounting operations, supporting financial reporting and month-end closing activities, coordinating audits, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing banking activities, and supporting treasury operations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong accounting knowledge, hands-on experience with financial reporting and reconciliations, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced fintech environment while ensuring compliance with IFRS, local regulations, and company policies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Accounting**

-   Record, review, and maintain accurate accounting transactions in the ERP/accounting system.
-   Ensure accounting entries comply with IFRS/IAS, Bangladesh Financial Reporting Standards (BFRS), and company policies.
-   Maintain general ledger, subsidiary ledgers, and chart of accounts.
-   Perform regular account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies promptly.
-   Maintain proper supporting documentation for all financial transactions.

**Accounts Payable & Payment Processing**

-   Verify vendor invoices, employee reimbursement claims, and supporting documents.
-   Ensure compliance with procurement, approval, and payment policies.
-   Coordinate with internal departments to resolve invoice-related discrepancies.
-   Prepare payment schedules and process payments accurately and on time.
-   Maintain vendor records and payment documentation.

**Financial Closing**

-   Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
-   Prepare journal entries, accruals, provisions, depreciation, amortization, and adjustment entries.
-   Reconcile bank accounts, receivables, payables, fixed assets, and intercompany balances.
-   Ensure timely completion of closing activities and reporting deadlines.

**Financial Reporting**

-   Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
-   Prepare management reports, dashboards, and financial analysis.
-   Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
-   Assist management with financial insights to support business decisions.
-   Ensure compliance with IFRS/BFRS and statutory reporting requirements.

**Audit & Regulatory Compliance**

-   Coordinate statutory audits and internal audit activities.
-   Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
-   Respond to audit queries and assist in implementing audit recommendations.
-   Ensure compliance with applicable tax, VAT, corporate, and regulatory requirements.
-   Support finance compliance reviews and internal control assessments.

**Regulatory Reporting**

-   Prepare and submit Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) reports and other regulatory filings.
-   Maintain complete documentation supporting regulatory submissions.
-   Assist in preparing Bangladesh Bank, NBR, RJSC, and other statutory reports as required.

**Banking & Treasury**

-   Coordinate with banks regarding account operations, remittances, loan facilities, and other banking matters.
-   Prepare daily and monthly bank reconciliations.
-   Monitor cash flow and treasury transactions.
-   Maintain banking documentation and support financing activities.
-   Assist in cash flow forecasting and liquidity management.

**Loan & Interest Management**

-   Calculate loan interest, accrued interest, and financing costs.
-   Verify interest charged by financial institutions.
-   Maintain loan schedules and repayment records.
-   Support financing-related documentation and reporting.

**Internal Controls & Process Improvement**

-   Ensure compliance with internal control procedures and finance policies.
-   Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and operational efficiency.
-   Support ERP implementation, finance automation initiatives, and process improvements.
-   Assist in strengthening financial governance and control frameworks.

**Other Responsibilities**

-   Support finance transformation projects and strategic initiatives.
-   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial processes.
-   Perform any other finance and accounting responsibilities assigned by management.

-   Ensure compliance with fire safety codes and regulatory requirements.

-   Work closely with Mechanical, electrical, and civil teams.

-   বিদ্যালয়ের শ্রেণিকক্ষ, অফিস কক্ষ, করিডোর, সিঁড়ি, বারান্দা, টয়লেট এবং ক্যাম্পাসের নির্ধারিত স্থানসমূহ নিয়মিত পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্ন রাখা।
-   প্রতিদিন অফিস ও শ্রেণিকক্ষ খোলার পূর্বে এবং ছুটি শেষে নির্ধারিত পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্নতার কাজ সম্পন্ন করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের টয়লেট, ওয়াশরুম ও হাত ধোয়ার স্থানসমূহ স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও ব্যবহার উপযোগী রাখা।
-   ময়লা-আবর্জনা নির্ধারিত স্থানে সংগ্রহ ও যথাযথভাবে অপসারণ করা।
-   শ্রেণিকক্ষের বেঞ্চ, টেবিল, চেয়ার, জানালা, দরজা এবং অন্যান্য আসবাবপত্র পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্ন রাখা।
-   স্কুল প্রাঙ্গণ, খেলার মাঠ, বাগান ও আশপাশের এলাকা পরিষ্কার রাখা এবং প্রয়োজনে আগাছা ও শুকনো পাতা অপসারণ করা।
-   পরিচ্ছন্নতা বজায় রাখতে প্রয়োজনীয় পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্নতার সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ যথাযথভাবে ব্যবহার ও সংরক্ষণ করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের অনুষ্ঠান, পরীক্ষা, সভা এবং অন্যান্য কার্যক্রমের আগে ও পরে পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্নতার কাজে সহায়তা করা।
-   স্বাস্থ্যবিধি, নিরাপত্তা নির্দেশিকা এবং পরিচ্ছন্নতা-সংক্রান্ত প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা যথাযথভাবে অনুসরণ করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের সম্পদ ও পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্নতার সরঞ্জামের সঠিক ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা।
-   শিক্ষার্থী, শিক্ষক, কর্মচারী এবং অভিভাবকদের সঙ্গে ভদ্র ও সহযোগিতাপূর্ণ আচরণ বজায় রাখা।
-   স্কুল কর্তৃপক্ষ কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্যান্য পরিচ্ছন্নতা ও সহায়ক দায়িত্ব নিষ্ঠার সঙ্গে পালন করা।

title: Security Guard (নিরাপত্তা প্রহরী)
description:
-   বিদ্যালয়ের ক্যাম্পাস, ভবন, শ্রেণিকক্ষ, অফিস, ল্যাবরেটরি এবং অন্যান্য স্থাপনার সার্বক্ষণিক নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের প্রবেশ ও বহির্গমন নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা এবং দর্শনার্থীদের তথ্য যথাযথভাবে নিবন্ধন করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের নির্ধারিত সময় অনুযায়ী গেট খোলা ও বন্ধ করা এবং নিরাপত্তা বিধি অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের সম্পদ, আসবাবপত্র, কম্পিউটার, ল্যাব সরঞ্জাম এবং অন্যান্য মূল্যবান সামগ্রী সুরক্ষিত রাখা।
-   সন্দেহজনক ব্যক্তি, অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত ঘটনা বা নিরাপত্তা ঝুঁকি শনাক্ত হলে তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা এবং প্রয়োজনীয় ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা।
-   নিয়মিত ক্যাম্পাস টহল প্রদান করে নিরাপদ ও শৃঙ্খলাপূর্ণ পরিবেশ বজায় রাখা।
-   জরুরি পরিস্থিতি যেমন অগ্নিকাণ্ড, দুর্ঘটনা বা প্রাকৃতিক দুর্যোগে প্রতিষ্ঠানের জরুরি নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
-   বিদ্যালয়ের অনুষ্ঠান, পরীক্ষা, ভর্তি কার্যক্রম এবং অন্যান্য বিশেষ আয়োজনে নিরাপত্তা ব্যবস্থাপনায় সহায়তা করা।
-   সিসিটিভি (যদি থাকে) পর্যবেক্ষণ করা এবং নিরাপত্তা-সংক্রান্ত ঘটনা রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণে সহযোগিতা করা।
-   শিক্ষার্থী, শিক্ষক, কর্মচারী এবং অভিভাবকদের সঙ্গে ভদ্র, দায়িত্বশীল ও পেশাদার আচরণ বজায় রাখা।
-   পরিচ্ছন্ন, শৃঙ্খলাবদ্ধ ও নিরাপদ ক্যাম্পাস পরিবেশ বজায় রাখতে প্রশাসনকে সহযোগিতা করা।
-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা, নিরাপত্তা নির্দেশিকা এবং স্কুল কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশনা যথাযথভাবে অনুসরণ করা।
-   স্কুল কর্তৃপক্ষ কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্যান্য নিরাপত্তা ও প্রশাসনিক দায়িত্ব নিষ্ঠার সঙ্গে পালন করা।

title: Physiotherapist
description:
-   Assess patients and identify their physiotherapy and rehabilitation needs.
    
-   Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.
    
-   Provide physiotherapy treatments including therapeutic exercises, manual therapy, electrotherapy, and rehabilitation programs.
    
-   Provide physiotherapy services to OPD and IPD patients.
    
-   Provide home physiotherapy services when required.
    
-   Monitor and document patients’ progress and treatment outcomes.
    
-   Educate patients and attendants on exercises, posture, mobility, and home-care programs.
    
-   Maintain proper patient records and treatment documentation.
    
-   Ensure safe and proper use of physiotherapy equipment.
    
-   Coordinate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals.
    
-   Maintain patient confidentiality, professional ethics, and hospital standards.
    

-   Perform other duties as assigned by the management.

title: 3D Technical Designer
description:
As the 3D Technical Designer your mission is to have strong knowledge of CLO3D, pattern making, engineering prints, and graphics development. The candidate will be responsible for creating accurate 3D garments, supporting product development, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure design and technical requirements are met.

**Job Responsibilities**

-   Create and develop accurate 3D garment simulations using CLO3D.
-   Develop and modify garment patterns based on design requirements.
-   Prepare and review engineering prints/technical packs for production.
-   Create and update garment graphics, artworks, and print placements.
-   Ensure fit, construction, and styling accuracy in 3D samples.
-   Collaborate with designers, merchandisers, and technical teams during product development.
-   Conduct virtual fittings, 3D size set and incorporate comments from buyers and internal teams.
-   Support innovation and continuous improvement in the 3D development process.

title: UI & UX Designer
description:
mPower is a pioneer and global leader in “Development Intelligence”, business intelligence for the social development in government and non-government sectors. If you are passionate about changing the world and improving the lives of millions of poor and disadvantaged people of the world combining both creativity & cutting-edge technology, apply for our UI & UX Designer vacancy.  
We are looking for a user experience design professional passionate about human-centered design exercises for an exciting array of b2b and b2c products that mPower is developing.  
**Duty Station:** Head Office in Gulshan, Dhaka with occasional field visits as per project needs  
**Job Responsibility:**

-   Lead the end-to-end UI/UX and Human-Centered Design (HCD) process, from user research and problem discovery to ideation, prototyping, usability testing, and final product delivery.
    
-   Use modern AI-assisted design tools and workflows, including Claude, Figma Make, Figma AI, and other emerging AI design tools, to accelerate design exploration, generate design concepts, iterate prototypes, and improve design efficiency.
    
-   Combine AI-generated design outputs with human judgment, creativity, accessibility, and interaction design principles to ensure the final product is intuitive, usable, inclusive, and aligned with real user needs.
    
-   Translate business requirements, user needs, and complex workflows into user-friendly digital experiences, information architectures, user journeys, wireframes, high-fidelity UI designs, and interactive prototypes.
    
-   Develop and iterate sketches, wireframes, mockups, design systems, and functional prototypes using tools such as Figma and Figma Make throughout the product development lifecycle.
    
-   Apply A/B testing, usability testing, analytics, and product performance insights to continuously improve user experience and validate design decisions.
    
-   Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, AI/ML engineers, researchers, business teams, and clients to transform ideas and requirements into practical and scalable digital solutions.

-   স্কুলের বার্ষিক ক্রীড়া প্রতিযোগিতা, আন্তঃশ্রেণি ও আন্তঃবিদ্যালয় ক্রীড়া প্রতিযোগিতা এবং অন্যান্য ক্রীড়া কার্যক্রম পরিকল্পনা ও পরিচালনা করা।

-   খেলাধুলার সরঞ্জাম ও মাঠের সুষ্ঠু ব্যবহার, সংরক্ষণ এবং নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা।

-   খেলাধুলা ও শরীরচর্চার সময় নিরাপত্তা বিধি অনুসরণ নিশ্চিত করা এবং প্রাথমিক চিকিৎসা (First Aid) সম্পর্কে প্রয়োজনীয় জ্ঞান প্রয়োগ করা।
-   জাতীয় দিবস, কুচকাওয়াজ, স্কাউট, বিএনসিসি (যদি প্রযোজ্য হয়), সাংস্কৃতিক ও সহশিক্ষা কার্যক্রমে সক্রিয় ভূমিকা পালন করা।
-   শিক্ষার্থীদের স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত জীবনযাপন, পুষ্টি, পরিচ্ছন্নতা এবং মানসিক সুস্থতা সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা সৃষ্টি করা।
-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের একাডেমিক নীতিমালা, শৃঙ্খলা ও প্রশাসনিক নির্দেশনা যথাযথভাবে অনুসরণ করা।
-   বিভাগীয় সভা, শিক্ষক প্রশিক্ষণ ও পেশাগত উন্নয়নমূলক কার্যক্রমে অংশগ্রহণ করা।
-   স্কুল কর্তৃপক্ষ কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্যান্য একাডেমিক ও প্রশাসনিক দায়িত্ব নিষ্ঠার সঙ্গে পালন করা।

title: Sr. AI / ML Engineer
description:
mPower is a pioneer and global leader in “Development Intelligence”, business intelligence for the social development in government and non-government sectors. If you are passionate about changing the world and improving the lives of millions of poor and disadvantaged people of the world combining both creativity & cutting-edge technology, apply for our Sr. AI/ML Engineer vacancy.  
**Duty Station:** Head Office in Gulshan, Dhaka with occasional field visits as per project needs.  
**Job Description:** As a Sr. AI/ML Engineer at mPower, you will join our core engineering team to build, optimize, and maintain production-ready machine learning solutions across our enterprise portfolio. Your work will focus on expanding our core capabilities in Natural Language Processing (NLP), predictive modeling, and data-driven automation. This role is ideal for a versatile engineer who thrives on solving complex language and structural data challenges in a low-profile, high-impact commercial environment.  
**Job Responsibilities:**

-   Fine-tune language and predictive models using custom datasets.
    
-   Optimize algorithms to process mixed language unstructured data pipelines.
    
-   Build and query graph-structured databases, relational networks, and vector repositories.
    
-   Construct clean, automated backend pipelines for multi-modal inputs.
    
-   Design, optimize, manage, secure bidirectional API to link AI/ML models with active enterprise solutions.
    
-   Run regular audits using semantic scoring metrics to track factual consistency and prevent system hallucinations.
    
-   Conduct technical stress testing to verify compliance.
    
-   Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback and mentor junior team members.

Research Officer
description:
mPower is a pioneer and global leader in “Development Intelligence”, business intelligence for the social development in government and non-government sectors. If you are passionate about changing the world and improving the lives of millions of poor and disadvantaged people of the world combining both creativity & cutting-edge technology, apply for our Research Officer vacancy.  
**Duty Station:** Head Office in Gulshan, Dhaka with occasional field visits as per project needs  
Job Description:

As a Research Officer at mPower, you will bridge the gap between community mental health counseling encounters and structured framework analysis. Utilizing your clinical or psychological background, and the on-job training provided, you will analyze session notes and counseling transcripts to isolate structural stressors, environmental determinants, and localized expressions of distress. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who wants to shape culturally grounded, ethically sound community mental health tools without needing a technical computer science background.  
**Job Responsibilities:**

-   Systematically review, format, and de-identify longitudinal counseling transcripts collected from community screening sites.
    
-   Lead isolation of explicit symptoms, social determinants, expression of distress, and map relations between them.
    
-   Triangulate clinical session inferences with data gathered from community Focus Group Discussions (FGDs) and expert anthropological workshops.
    
-   Format extracted behavioral and structural nodes to help build the project\`s Hierarchical Causal Knowledge Graph.
    
-   Assist in regular bias audits to ensure the documented data paths do not oversimplify client distress or miss crucial psychiatric referral flags.
    
-   Coordinate with lived-experience advocacy networks to validate that terms are mapped in a non-stigmatizing, culturally respectful manner.
