title: Technical Coordinator
description:
**Job Context**

Uttaran is an NGO working in Bangladesh since 1985 to uphold rights and entitlements and to improve the socio-economic condition of the poor and disadvantaged community people. Uttaran is a people-centered organization using a rights-based approach to alleviate poverty, diversify livelihood opportunities and empower poor communities of Bangladesh.

Uttaran invites applications for the vacant position titled- Technical Coordinator for the Actions to Climate Change Ensuring Sustainable Solutions (ACCESS) Project.

**Reports to:** Project Operation Manager.

**Position Overview**

The Actions to Climate Change Ensuring Sustainable Solutions (ACCESS) project works across nine thematic areas (agriculture and livelihoods, disaster risk reduction, climate migration, climate governance, climate finance, loss and damage, inclusive WASH, and natural resources management) to increase climate and disaster resilience of communities. Thus, being a technically heavy component project, a highly qualified individual is required to support the Project Operation Manager in the overall technical coordination of the project. The Technical Coordinator will play a key role in providing technical assistance and ensuring quality in all implemented project activities, working closely with the Project Operation Manager, Technical Officers, MEAL officer, Knowledge Management and Advocacy officer of the team. He/she will also coordinate technical inputs with Helvetas’s Technical Specialist and Project Coordinators.

**Key Responsibilities**

-   Technical Coordination, Implementation, and Quality Assurance
    
    -   Support and backstop the Project Operation Manager and technical officers in technical planning of detailed workplans for effective implementation of the project activities
        
    -   Collate and provide substantive and strategic technical advice on the different thematic components, to technical officers and stakeholders, to perform tasks related to project activities efficiently and effectively
        
    -   Coordinate the technical aspects of activities within and among interventions/models to ensure that the project objectives are met and to innovate and bring synergies among the different project activities
        
    -   Support in producing and reviewing all technical documents produced within the project like concept notes, technical briefs, project related reports, outputs among others and take a lead in the quality assurance of all technical documents
        
    -   Keep track of the Gantt Chart and follow up with technical officers on critical actions
        

-   Knowledge generation, supervision, and management
    
    -   Regularly update self-knowledge—studying from both primary and secondary sources—on concepts, approaches, practices, and lessons related to project interventions at national and international levels. Also regularly update the implementation and donor team through presentations, workshops, and/or project reports
        
    -   Actively engage and promote teamwork, information sharing and collaboration within the project team and between project partners
        
    -   Guide and contribute to the technical quality of communications materials and reporting highlighting the project’s work and the results achieved for people and the system actors through traditional and non-traditional media (e.g., news articles, blogs, photo stories, social media), in accordance with respective communication and branding guidelines
        
    -   Assist the Project Operation Manager in producing the content of reports and handouts and sharing them with stakeholders and partners
        
    -   Draft agendas, correspondence, memos, letters, recommendations, proposals/concept notes, and other project related documentations and correspondences, as appropriate
        

-   Capacity Building
    
    -   Contribute to systematic capacity building by identifying capacity needs, develop capacity building plans for the project team (technical officers, assistant project officers), and consult with the Project Operation Manager
        
    -   Develop capacity building plans for various project stakeholders, including government officials, communities, service providers, across a wide range of interventions; and facilitate the implementation
        
    -   Facilitate the implementation of the capacity development activities by coordinating with technical departments and consultants for planning and implementing training modules and orientations
        
    -   Support in reviewing outline of all training curricula and provide inputs to capacity development content from the perspective of mainstreaming adaptation and ensuring sustainability
        

-   Policy Engagement, Stakeholder Liaison, Collaboration and Networking
    
    -   Establish and maintain strong communication and networking with government and non-government stakeholders
        
    -   Liaise and coordinate with respective local governments, academic and research institutions, and private sector stakeholders to implement project activities and to ensure the effective delivery of project services
        
    -   Support in facilitating policy dialogue and consultation events at the regional level i
        
    -   Build and maintain strong relationships with local authorities, community leaders, and partner organizations
        
    -   Be proactive in establishing a good network among stakeholders to increase the ownership of the interventions
        
    -   Contribute to proposal development, revisions, and donor engagement processes
        

-   Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting
    
    -   Support the Project Operation Manager in managing and monitoring the project team (technical officers, assistant project officers, consultants, 3rd party contractors etc.) and ensure timely implementation, results–orientation and accountability for project results
        
    -   Provide appropriate, technical programme management inputs to regular reports (monthly, quarterly, and annually) and propose any changes in activities to be implemented in the next reporting period
        
    -   Actively make field visits, collaborate with local counterparts and/or facilitate arrangements for joint monitoring visits to project sites to monitor and provide technical inputs
        
    -   Guide and provide inputs to the documentation of the processes, lessons learned, best practices, case studies, design and conduction of surveys, assessments, and other relevant information regularly that feed into the project’s reporting and knowledge management system.
        
    -   Analyze data technically to assess the quality and effectiveness of interventions and provide regular updates to the Project Operation Manager
        

-   Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI)
    
    -   Ensure integration of GESI principles across all project interventions.
        
    -   Promote inclusion of women, youth, persons with disabilities, and marginalized groups in planning and implementation.
        
    -   Ensure GESI-sensitive approaches in service delivery, communication, and advocacy
        

**Other Responsibilities**

-   Perform any other duties assigned by the Project Coordinator to ensure effective project implementation.

-   Proficient in conducting coagulation/flocculation (Jar/Bucket) tests, preparing mother solutions, and ensuring effective water disinfection through inline chlorination.
    
-   Demonstrated experience in wastewater sample collection from fecal sludge treatment plants.
    
-   Adhering to strict safety protocols to ensure the safe handling of fecal sludge and other hazardous materials.
    
-   Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the program’s goals on safeguarding implementation.

The successful candidate should be positive, energetic, commercially ambitious and comfortable building opportunities from the ground up. The role requires strong market engagement, disciplined execution and the ability to convert client business needs into relevant technology-solution opportunities with support from internal technical and delivery teams.

# **Key Responsibilities:**

## **Direct Revenue Generation:**

-   Develop and execute a Bangladesh-focused corporate B2B sales plan aligned with the company’s growth priorities.

-   Track market trends, competitor activity and customer requirements and convert insights into practical growth initiatives.
    

-   Represent the company professionally in client visits, business forums, industry events and networking platforms.
    

## **Team Leadership and Sales Discipline:**

-   Set clear revenue targets, activity standards, pipeline expectations and accountability measures for the sales team.

## **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

The Deputy Manager- Learning and Documentation will support the Project Coordinator in strengthening the Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) functions of the DFAT-funded Bangladesh Rohingya and Host Communities Humanitarian Response Programme. The role will lead the coordination and quality assurance of programme monitoring systems, indicator tracking, data analysis, reporting, and evidence generation to support adaptive programme management and donor compliance. Working closely with programme sectors and the MEAL team, the position will facilitate results measurement, learning, and quality assessments while supporting the preparation of donor reports, maintaining programme documentation, and promoting evidence-based decision-making across the programme.

**MAJOR** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Operational :** The Deputy Manager will support the programme's Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) functions by:

-   Tracking programme progress against approved DIPs, workplans, logframes, and indicator targets.
-   Collect, consolidate, analyse, and validate monitoring data received from programme sectors.
-   Support the implementation and periodic review of the programme's MEAL framework to ensure alignment with donor requirements, organisational priorities, and programme objectives.
-   Support the development and refinement of programme indicators, results frameworks, and performance measurement plans.
-   Coordinate cross-sector performance reviews and facilitate evidence-based discussions to inform programme planning and decision-making.
-   Conduct routine data quality assurance (DQA), data verification, and consistency checks across programme databases.
-   Maintain programme quality trackers, indicator matrices, dashboards, and MEAL databases.
-   Prepare routine programme performance summaries, dashboards, factsheets, newsletters, and analytical reports for management and donors.
-   Identify implementation bottlenecks, data gaps, quality issues, and operational risks through regular monitoring.
-   Follow up on agreed action points arising from programme review meetings, monitoring visits, donor recommendations, and management decisions.
-   Coordinate monitoring visits, field verification exercises, assessments, surveys, and evaluation activities.
-   Document lessons learned, good practices, needs and gap analysis, programme innovations, and evidence generated through implementation.
-   Monitor accountability mechanisms, including community feedback, complaints, and response tracking.
-   Maintain supporting evidence and documentation required for programme monitoring, audits, evaluations, and donor reporting.
-   Provide logistical support in capacity development initiatives.
-   **People skills:**
-   Foster effective collaboration among programme sectors and support units to strengthen integrated programme implementation.
-   Coordinate with sector teams to ensure timely submission of quality monitoring data, reports, and supporting documentation.
-   Provide technical support to programme teams on donor reporting requirements, indicator definitions, and documentation standards.

**Learning and Knowledge Management:**

-   Coordinate the preparation of donor reports, including quarterly reports, annual reports, executive summaries, programme briefs, one-pagers, concept notes, donor visit briefs, and presentations.
-   Ensure consistency and quality of information across all programme reports and communication products.
-   Maintain the programme reporting calendar and monitor timely submission of reporting deliverables.
-   Develop and maintain programme knowledge management systems, including programme repositories, evidence databases, research repositories, learning archives, and documentation libraries.
-   Coordinate documentation of lessons learned, best practices, success stories, case studies, programme snapshots, and humanitarian updates.
-   Organise learning workshops, reflection sessions, after-action reviews, and knowledge-sharing events to promote continuous programme improvement.

**Safeguarding:**

Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.

title: Assistant Manager - Finance and Administration
description:
**Context:**

The French NGO better with water has created the social business Shobar Jonno Pani Ltd. and the NGO Water & Life Bangladesh in 2010 and now operating under the trademark of better with water Bangladesh.

The overall objective of BWW Bangladesh is to improve the living conditions of low income communities in depressed urban areas of Bangladesh based on water supply.

BWW Bangladesh sets up, maintains and operates the water supply network in the targeted areas, on top of which it ensures the implementation of the sanitation & social activities (Hygiene promotion, Fire-fighting, Solid waste management, Community mobilisation). This is the first time in Bangladeshi slums that water is provided through household connection and based on a social enterprise model.

BWW Bangladesh engaged in partnerships with the local communities, authorities, water operator and other development stakeholders.

-   **Location:** Head Office, Gulshan
    
-   **Reporting to:** Finance and Administration Manager
    

**Tasks & responsibilities:**

-   Maintain accurate books of accounts and ensure timely recording of all financial transactions in Odoo,
    
-   Verify accounting vouchers and supporting documents, ensuring compliance with organizational policies, VAT and tax regulations.
    
-   Prepare bank reconciliation statements, monitor cash flow and maintain financial registers.
    
-   Assist in the preparation of annual budgets, rolling forecasts, financial statements and variance analysis.
    
-   Prepare financial reports in accordance with IFRS and IAS standards.
    
-   Ensure timely submission of VAT, Tax, TDS and other statutory returns while maintaining compliance with NBR, RJSC, NGOAB and Bangladesh Bank requirements.
    
-   Support internal and external audits and ensure timely implementation of audit recommendations.
    
-   Coordinate with NGO Affairs Bureau (NGOAB) for FD-4, FD-6, fund release, work permits and other regulatory matters.
    
-   Prepare monthly payroll, overtime, festival bonuses, salary transfer sheets and employee final settlements.
    
-   Administer employee benefits, including provident fund, gratuity and group insurance.
    
-   Oversee procurement, logistics, agreements, travel arrangements and hotel bookings.
    
-   Provide administrative and basic IT support to ensure smooth office operations.
    
-   Supervise and support the Finance and Administration team to ensure efficient departmental operations.

**About the Role**

I'm a product founder building two things, and this role sits across both:

-   A portfolio of our own apps on the Atlassian Marketplace (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management), built on the Forge platform.
-   A software developer staff-augmentation service (launching soon) — where we place our developers with external clients to work on the client's projects.
-   Here's how that works in practice for you:
-   When you're booked by a client, you work on that client's projects as part of their team.
-   When you're not booked, you work on our own Atlassian Marketplace apps.
-   That means there's always meaningful work — you're never idle between client bookings — and you get variety: real client products and our own product line. The client work runs on \*\*normal business hours. No uncommon shifts, no late-night hours.
-   I'm looking for one skilled developer to own the technical side of this long-term — from building and launching new apps to delivering solid work for clients. This is not a short-term project. I want someone who wants to grow with a product business and take genuine ownership of what they build.

**What You'll Be Working On**

**On our own products:**

-   Building new apps for the Atlassian Marketplace using the Forge platform
-   Owning the full development lifecycle — from spec to deployment to post-launch iteration
-   Building Custom UI components in React that run inside Jira and Confluence
-   Writing backend logic with Node.js / TypeScript using Forge resolvers and Forge storage
-   Integrating with the \*\*Jira REST API, Confluence REST API\*\*, and external services (LLM APIs, webhooks)
-   Maintaining and iterating on live apps based on real user feedback

**On client work (staff augmentation):**

-   Delivering development work for client projects when booked, working as part of the client's team
-   Communicating clearly and professionally with the client on progress, blockers, and timelines
-   Across both: communicating clearly on progress, blockers, and timelines, and flagging problems early rather than going quiet.

**What This Is Not**

This is not a role for someone who needs constant hand-holding or close technical supervision. I'm a non-technical founder, so I need someone who can read a product brief, ask the right clarifying questions, and then execute. I handle product direction. You handle the technical execution.

If you need someone to review every line of code or answer technical questions daily, this role is not the right fit.

ইলেকট্রনিক্স পণ্য, সিভিল কনস্ট্রাকশন ম্যাটেরিয়ালস, ফ্যাসিলিটি ম্যানেজমেন্ট অথবা করপোরেট মেইনটেন্যান্স সার্ভিস বিক্রয়ের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।

**দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য (Job Responsibilities)**

-   কোম্পানির সেবা ও পণ্যের জন্য নতুন করপোরেট ক্লায়েন্ট এবং ব্যবসায়িক সুযোগ (Business Opportunity) শনাক্ত ও উন্নয়ন করা।
-   Corporate Sales Lead Generation, Client Prospecting এবং Sales Pipeline কার্যকরভাবে পরিচালনা করা।
-   করপোরেট ক্লায়েন্টদের সাথে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি ও Client Retention নিশ্চিত করা।
-   ক্লায়েন্টের প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী কোটেশন, প্রস্তাবনা (Proposal), টেন্ডার ডকুমেন্ট এবং প্রেজেন্টেশন প্রস্তুত করা।
-   ইলেকট্রনিক্স পণ্য, সিভিল কনস্ট্রাকশন ম্যাটেরিয়ালস এবং মেইনটেন্যান্স সার্ভিসের বিক্রয় কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা।
-   সেলস টার্গেট অর্জনের লক্ষ্যে মাসিক, ত্রৈমাসিক ও বার্ষিক সেলস পরিকল্পনা প্রণয়ন ও বাস্তবায়ন করা।
-   সেলস টিমকে নেতৃত্ব প্রদান, প্রশিক্ষণ, তদারকি এবং কর্মদক্ষতা মূল্যায়ন করা।
-   বিক্রয়-পরবর্তী (After Sales Service) সেবা নিশ্চিত করে গ্রাহক সন্তুষ্টি বজায় রাখা।
-   ক্লায়েন্টের পাওনা আদায় (Debt Collection) নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে নিশ্চিত করা এবং Accounts টিমের সাথে সমন্বয় করা।
-   বাজার বিশ্লেষণ, প্রতিযোগীদের কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং নতুন ব্যবসায়িক কৌশল প্রণয়ন করা।
-   বিভিন্ন শিল্প প্রতিষ্ঠান, বহুজাতিক কোম্পানি, ব্যাংক, হাসপাতাল, রিয়েল এস্টেট, করপোরেট হাউজ ও অন্যান্য প্রতিষ্ঠানের সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণকারীদের (Decision Makers) সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ বজায় রাখা।
-   নিয়মিত Sales Report, Forecast এবং Management Report প্রস্তুত ও উপস্থাপন করা।

title: Counsellor/ Sr. Counsellor
description:
**Job Summary:** The Education Counsellor is responsible for managing leads, guiding students through the application process, and ensuring successful enrollment. This role involves making lead calls, providing counselling to potential students, identifying their needs, recommending suitable courses and universities, assisting with applications and maintaining communication with students until course completion. The Education Counsellor also participates in education fairs and undertakes additional tasks as assigned by management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

-   Ensure a positive and welcoming work environment.
-   Make lead calls to potential students. Perform a minimum of 60 to 70 calls daily.
-   Ensure to work on a minimum of 30 leads and 15 files on a daily basis.
-   Identify credible leads and filter them based on quality criteria.
-   Categorize leads into various stages such as cold, appointment booked, future interest, etc.
-   Update all the leads status instantly on CRM. Review and provide a status description for every leads & files (In Process to Payment Expected) in CRM.
-   Provide updates on applications, offer letters, payments, etc., and ensure proper alignment on CRM.
-   Ensure to meet the 72 HR timeline for file processing.
-   Ensure timely submission of Daily, Weekly and Monthly reports. Provide comprehensive counseling to students, understanding their needs and preferences.
-   Develop relationships with credible students and maintain ongoing communication.
-   Assist students in identifying suitable courses and universities based on their budget, location preference, and other factor.
-   Present multiple options (at least 2) to students for consideration. Collect required documents from students (Passport, CV, Academic documents, English test certificate, Reference letters, SOP).Guide students through the application process, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
-   Assist students in obtaining offer letters and unconditional offer letters
-   Prioritize offer letter chase after 72hrs of application; communicate priorities to higher management.
-   Prepare students for CAS interviews in collaboration with the compliance department.
-   Assist in obtaining CAS and submit CAS requests if necessary.
-   Collaborate with the visa application team to facilitate the visa application process.
-   Collect feedback from students and encourage positive word-of-mouth referrals.
-   Maintain continuous communication with students from enrollment to course completion.
-   Ensure to inform managers before leaving the office at the end of the day.
-   Prevent misuse of break time; obtain approval for breaks and lunch outside the office.
-   Participate in education fairs to represent the organization.
-   Ensure all students and guests feel welcome and valued during the events.
-   Undertake any other tasks assigned by management to support the organization's objectives.

title: Office Support Staff
description:
দৈনন্দিন প্রশাসনিক ও অপারেশনাল কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার জন্য একজন দায়িত্বশীল, কর্মঠ, সৎ ও কর্মনিষ্ঠ **অফিস সাপোর্ট স্টাফ** নিয়োগ দেওয়া হবে। প্রার্থীকে অফিসের প্রশাসনিক কার্যক্রম, ডকুমেন্ট ব্যবস্থাপনা, গ্রাহকসেবা, অফিস সমন্বয় এবং ম্যানেজমেন্টের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন দায়িত্ব পালন করতে হবে।

### **প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ:**

-   অফিসের দৈনন্দিন প্রশাসনিক কার্যক্রম সুষ্ঠুভাবে পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করা।
-   সকল ধরনের অফিস ফাইল, ডকুমেন্ট, রেকর্ড ও রেজিস্টার সংরক্ষণ এবং হালনাগাদ রাখা।
-   অফিসে আগত অতিথি, ক্লায়েন্ট ও ভিজিটরদের যথাযথভাবে গ্রহণ ও সহায়তা প্রদান।
-   অফিসের টেলিফোন কল গ্রহণ, বার্তা নথিভুক্তকরণ এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তির কাছে পৌঁছে দেওয়া।
-   বিভিন্ন তথ্য সংগ্রহ, ডাটা এন্ট্রি এবং রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করা।
-   Microsoft Word, Excel, ই-মেইল এবং ইন্টারনেট ব্যবহার করে অফিস কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা।
-   অফিসের ইনভেন্টরি, স্টেশনারি ও প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের হিসাব সংরক্ষণ করা।
-   অফিসের বিভিন্ন চিঠিপত্র, আবেদনপত্র ও ডকুমেন্ট প্রিন্ট, স্ক্যান, ফটোকপি এবং ফাইলিং করা।
-   কুরিয়ার, ব্যাংক, সরকারি ও বেসরকারি প্রতিষ্ঠানে প্রয়োজনীয় অফিসিয়াল কাজ সম্পন্ন করা।
-   শিক্ষার্থী, অভিভাবক ও ক্লায়েন্টদের প্রাথমিক তথ্য ও প্রয়োজনীয় সহায়তা প্রদান।
-   অফিস মিটিং, প্রশিক্ষণ এবং বিভিন্ন ইভেন্ট আয়োজনের ক্ষেত্রে সহায়তা করা।
-   অফিসের পরিচ্ছন্নতা, শৃঙ্খলা ও কর্মপরিবেশ বজায় রাখতে সহায়তা করা।
-   প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া ও অনলাইন প্ল্যাটফর্মে তথ্য আপডেট করতে সহায়তা করা।
-   ম্যানেজমেন্টের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন বিভাগকে প্রশাসনিক সহায়তা প্রদান।
-   অফিসের গোপনীয় তথ্য ও নথিপত্রের নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা।

নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে অর্পিত কাজ সম্পন্ন করে নিয়মিত অগ্রগতি রিপোর্ট প্রদান।

### **অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব**

-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের স্বার্থে অতিরিক্ত দায়িত্ব গ্রহণে আগ্রহী হতে হবে।ম্যানেজমেন্ট কর্তৃক অর্পিত যেকোনো বৈধ ও অফিস-সংক্রান্ত দায়িত্ব যথাযথভাবে পালন করতে হবে।
-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতি, শৃঙ্খলা ও পেশাগত আচরণবিধি মেনে চলতে হবে।
-   কাজের প্রতি জবাবদিহিতা, সততা ও দায়িত্বশীলতা প্রদর্শন করতে হবে।

### **বেতন ও সুযোগ-সুবিধা**

-   বেতন: আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে।
-   কর্মদক্ষতার ভিত্তিতে ইনক্রিমেন্ট ও পদোন্নতির সুযোগ।
-   উৎসব ভাতা।
-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুযোগ-সুবিধা।

title: Flight Reservation Officer
description:
Journey Expert Ltd. is seeking a smart, energetic, and target-oriented Flight Reservation Officer to manage flight reservations, ticketing operations, customer support, and airline communications. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of airline reservation systems, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work under pressure while maintaining service quality.

-   Handle domestic and international flight reservations, ticket issuance, reissue, refund, and cancellation processes.
    
-   Provide accurate fare quotations and travel options to clients.
    
-   Operate airline reservation systems and OTA platforms efficiently.
    
-   Coordinate with airlines, consolidators, and suppliers regarding booking issues and schedule changes.
    
-   Assist clients with travel-related inquiries and provide timely solutions.
    
-   Monitor booking deadlines, ticketing time limits, and airline policies.
    
-   Ensure accurate passenger information and travel documentation requirements.
    
-   Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reservation and sales reports.
    
-   Maintain customer databases and booking records.
    
-   Follow up with potential and existing customers to maximize sales opportunities.
    
-   Handle customer complaints professionally and ensure customer satisfaction.
    
-   Support visa, travel insurance, and other travel-related service coordination when required.
    
-   Maintain effective communication with internal teams and management.
    
-   Achieve assigned sales and service targets.
    
-   Perform any additional tasks assigned by management for business development and operational success.

title: Visa & Tour Operations Officer
description:
-   Process and manage Student Visa, Tourist Visa, Business Visa, Visit Visa, Medical Visa, and other visa categories while ensuring compliance with embassy and immigration regulations.
-   Review, verify, organize, and maintain all visa-related documents before submission to embassies, high commissions, visa application centers, and immigration authorities.
-   Complete visa application forms accurately and ensure error-free documentation.
-   Provide professional visa consultation regarding eligibility, documentation requirements, immigration policies, financial requirements, and application procedures.
-   Coordinate with embassies, high commissions, visa application centers, airlines, universities, and overseas partners regarding visa applications and travel requirements.
-   Prepare and follow up on admission-related documents such as Offer Letters, CAS, COE, I-20, Enrollment Confirmation, and other supporting documents for student visa applications.

-   Schedule visa appointments, biometric enrollment, medical examinations, and embassy interview appointments.

-   Design, customize, price, and manage domestic and international tour packages according to client requirements.
-   Prepare detailed travel itineraries including flights, hotels, transfers, sightseeing, travel insurance, and other travel services.
-   Coordinate with airlines, hotels, destination management companies (DMCs), tour operators, and travel suppliers to ensure smooth service delivery.
-   Prepare quotations, invoices, travel vouchers, booking confirmations, and other operational documents.
-   Respond promptly to customer inquiries through phone calls, email, WhatsApp, social media, and other communication channels while maintaining excellent customer service.
-   Maintain accurate client records and regularly update the company's CRM/database with visa, booking, and tour information.
-   Participate in sales, marketing campaigns, educational fairs, travel expos, seminars, and promotional events to generate new business opportunities.
-   Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports and submit performance updates to management while ensuring compliance with company policies and service standards.
-   Perform any additional visa processing, tour operations, customer service, documentation, compliance, or administrative responsibilities assigned by management.

title: Accounts & Finance Manager
description:
**Company Description:**

KAC Fashion Wear Ltd. is a growing apparel company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, focused on delivering quality fashion products to international markets. The organization emphasizes efficient production, reliable supply chain operations, and strong financial discipline to support sustainable business growth. Team members collaborate across departments to ensure timely delivery, cost control, and customer satisfaction. The company values integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement, offering opportunities for professionals to contribute meaningfully to its expansion.

**Role Description:**

The Accounts & Finance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, responsible for overseeing the company’s financial operations and ensuring accurate reporting. BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh in 1972 that partners globally with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty to create opportunities to realise their potential.

The Deputy Project Manager – English Language and Digital Literacy Lab will lead the implementation and supervision of English language and digital literacy training programs for Rohingya and host community youth. This includes overseeing the lab setup, curriculum rollout, participant selection, and training delivery. The role ensures high-quality learning experiences, the integration of IELTS preparation, and coordination with stakeholders to support the socio-economic advancement and digital inclusion of participants.

**Program Implementation and Supervision:**

-   Oversee the day-to-day operations of the English and Digital Literacy Labs in camps and host communities.

-   Coordinate participant intake campaigns, eligibility screening, placement testing, and informed consent documentation.
-   Facilitate the timely provision of teaching-learning materials, visibility kits (T-shirts, bags), and digital tools.

**Academic Quality, Certification, and Assessment**

-   Support trainers in developing learner-centric lesson plans and interactive content.
-   Track learner attendance, performance, and progress using a digital MIS or manual tools.
-   Maintain participant records, including test scores and digital literacy assessment results.
-   Ensure consistency in curriculum delivery across locations, applying feedback for continuous improvement.

**Stakeholder Coordination, Reporting, and Safeguarding**

-   Liaise with the CiC, site management, and other sector actors to obtain permissions and ensure program coordination at the camp level.
-   Represent BRAC in local coordination forums and language and digital learning stakeholder groups.
-   Ensure safeguarding standards are followed by all staff and volunteers in learning environments.
-   Prepare activity reports (weekly and monthly) and contribute to donor reports, impact tracking, and documentation.
-   Organize and support capacity-building training on Safeguarding, Gender Equality, and Facilitation for lab staff.

**Safeguarding:**

-   Ensure the safety of Programme Participants, people who come into contact with the organisation and team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) to achieve the programme's goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
-   Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
-   Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so

title: Digital Marketer - Ads Strategy Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

Aline Mart is a curated luxury e-commerce platform serving the Bangladeshi market across perfume, skincare, haircare, and premium tech sourced through a vetted third-party vendor network and delivered with a signature 2-hour Dhaka promise. We\`re looking for a hands-on digital marketer with real Bangladesh e-commerce ad experience to own paid social performance end-to-end: someone who can build a Meta Ads account from the funnel up, read a pixel like a P&L, and turn a boosted post into a repeatable, profitable acquisition channel not just someone who\`s clicked "boost post" for a few years.

This is a lead-level individual contributor role: you\`ll run the campaigns yourself while also shaping the broader digital strategy alongside design, content, and leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Paid Campaign Strategy & Execution**

-   Own end-to-end Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) strategy: campaign structure, audience architecture, budget allocation, and bidding strategy across the full funnel — cold prospecting, warm retargeting, and hot cart-recovery audiences.
    
-   Build and manage layered targeting: interest-stacked and broad/Advantage+ prospecting, custom audiences (website visitors, video viewers, engagers, COD customer lists), and lookalike audiences built from purchasers and add-to-cart events.
    
-   Plan and execute geo-specific campaigns distinguishing Dhaka-metro (2-hour delivery eligible) from nationwide standard-delivery audiences, ensuring ad promises always match real fulfillment capability.
    
-   Manage day-to-day budget pacing, bid adjustments, and campaign optimization across Meta, with working knowledge of TikTok Ads and Google Ads as secondary/expansion channels.
    
-   Run structured A/B and multivariate testing on creative, copy, audiences, placements, and landing pages — document learnings and turn them into standing playbooks, not one-off wins.
    

**Funnel & Website Conversion Ownership**

-   Own the Meta Pixel and Conversions API implementation in partnership with the development team; ensure clean, deduplicated event tracking (ViewContent, Add-to-Cart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase) across [alinemart.com.](alinemart.com.)
    
-   Build and maintain the Meta product catalog for dynamic/catalog ads across the full SKU range.
    
-   Diagnose and prioritize on-site conversion friction (checkout drop-off, cart abandonment, page speed, payment method visibility) in collaboration with design and dev — you don\`t need to code the fix, but you need to spot the leak and make the business case for fixing it.
    
-   Design and manage always-on retargeting flows: cart abandoners, product viewers without purchase, and post-purchase cross-sell.
    
-   Own core funnel metrics — click-through rate, add-to-cart rate, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, conversion rate — and report on them with clear, actionable narrative, not just dashboards.
    

**Bangladesh Market & Audience Strategy**

-   Apply working knowledge of Bangladeshi digital consumer behavior: platform usage patterns (Facebook/Messenger dominance, Instagram\`s role for premium/female audiences, TikTok for discovery), COD preference, trust and authenticity concerns in online retail, and realistic engagement windows.
    
-   Tailor targeting, messaging, and creative briefs to reflect genuine local buying psychology rather than importing generic Western playbooks wholesale.
    
-   Stay current on platform algorithm changes, policy updates, and emerging ad formats relevant to the Bangladesh market, and adjust strategy proactively rather than reactively.
    

**Content & Creative Direction for Performance**

-   Brief the design/content team on ad creative requirements: what wins on Meta in this market (native video, price-on-image product shots, authenticity-forward messaging, mobile-first vertical formats).
    
-   Collaborate on and help execute a structured content calendar that supports paid amplification — knowing which organic posts are boost-worthy and why.
    
-   Write and refine ad copy (English and Bangla/Banglish) that reflects brand voice while optimizing for conversion — copy is not outsourced entirely to creative; you own the performance angle of it.
    

**Vendor-Model-Aware Campaign Planning**

-   Understand and work within Aline Mart\`s third-party vendor sourcing model: coordinate with the merchandising/vendor team to confirm stock and fulfillment capability before scaling ad spend behind any SKU.
    
-   Build "supply-resilient" campaign structures — avoid concentrating budget behind single-vendor, fragile-stock products; maintain backup creative and product swaps to prevent wasted spend on stockouts.
    
-   Flag and help enforce accurate delivery-promise messaging (e.g., which SKUs genuinely qualify for 2-hour Dhaka delivery) so ad claims never outrun real fulfillment.
    

**Reporting, Analytics & Strategic Input**

-   Deliver regular (weekly/monthly) performance reporting to leadership — clear, data-backed, and focused on decisions, not just numbers.
    
-   Build and maintain dashboards or structured reports tracking spend, ROAS, CAC, AOV, and funnel-stage conversion over time.
    
-   Contribute directly to broader digital marketing strategy: channel mix, budget planning, seasonal/campaign calendars (Eid, festival seasons, sales events), and new-channel evaluation.
    
-   Partner with leadership on marketing budget forecasting and present data-backed recommendations on where to scale, pause, or reallocate spend.
    

**Team & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

-   Work closely with design, content, merchandising/vendor management, and customer service teams to ensure ad promises, product availability, and customer experience stay aligned.
    
-   Where applicable, brief and manage freelance or junior support (creative assistants, community management) involved in campaign execution.
    
-   Represent the paid/performance function in broader marketing planning discussions, bringing a data-informed perspective to creative and strategic decisions.

**Position Purpose**

-   Ensure uninterrupted operation of all civil infrastructure.
    

**Factory Engineering Coordination**

Although based at the Corporate Office, the incumbent will regularly visit factory locations to:

-   Monitor ongoing civil construction and infrastructure projects.
    
-   Review engineering progress and contractor performance.
    
-   Inspect building conditions and recommend corrective actions.
    
-   Support factory engineering teams on civil engineering matters.
    
-   Coordinate renovation and expansion projects.

**Compliance & Safety**

-   Ensure compliance with BNBC, RAJUK, Fire Service, Department of Environment, and other statutory requirements.

-   Conduct structural inspections and engineering risk assessments.

-   Coordinate statutory inspections and engineering approvals where required.
    

**Budget & Cost Control**

-   Control CAPEX and OPEX related to civil engineering activities.
    
-   Evaluate contractor quotations and recommend technically suitable vendors.

-   Monitor project expenditures against approved budgets.
    

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

title: Store In-Charge (Accessories & Trimmings)
description:
**Raw Material & Stock Management**

-   **Inventory Control:** Maintain real-time stock counts for raw yarns, rubber threads, chemicals, inks, and sticker paper.
-   **Storage Optimization:** Organize materials systematically using a FIFO (First-In, First-Out) system to prevent shelf-life expiration, especially for adhesives and elastics.
-   **Receiving & Verification:** Inspect incoming raw materials against purchase orders for correct quantity, weight, and batch numbers.
-   **System Logging:** Update the ERP system or digital ledger immediately upon receiving or issuing materials.

**Issuance & Production Support**

-   **Material Requisition:** Issue correct quantities of yarn, rubber, or tape to the production floor based on approved requisition slips.
-   **Batch Tracking:** Ensure specific dye batches of sewing thread or specific lots of elastic are issued together to avoid color shading mix-ups on the production line.
-   **Reorder Alerts:** Monitor minimum stock levels and send alerts to the procurement team before critical items run out.

**Finished Goods & Dispatch Coordination**

-   **Safe Storage:** Store finished threads, tapes, and stickers in a clean, dry, dust-free environment to prevent moisture damage or staining.
-   **Challan Generation:** Prepare delivery challans, packing lists, and gate passes for outgoing shipments to apparel factories.
-   **Loading Supervision:** Oversee the secure loading of cartons onto delivery vehicles to prevent damage during transit.

**Security & Maintenance**

-   **Housekeeping:** Maintain strict cleanliness, internal bin labeling, and clear gangways across the warehouse floor.
-   **Security Audits:** Conduct weekly or monthly physical stock verifications to reconcile actual stock with system records and investigate discrepancies.
-   **Safety Protocols:** Enforce fire safety measures and correct chemical storage guidelines for inks or adhesives.

title: ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)
description:
**জব কনটেক্সট:** পল্লী বিকাশ কেন্দ্র মাইক্রোক্রেডিট রেগুলেটরি অথরিটি কর্তৃক সনদপ্রাপ্ত (সনদ নং:-০০৫২৯-০৩৯৯৬-০০১৯০) এবং পিকেএসএফ, বিভিন্ন ব্যাংক, আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং নিজস্ব অর্থায়নে পরিচালিত একটি জাতীয় পর্যায়ের বেসরকারী উন্নয়ন সংস্থা। দরিদ্র জনগোষ্ঠির আর্থ-সামাজিক উন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে পল্লী বিকাশ কেন্দ্র দেশের বিভিন্ন জেলায় শহর ও গ্রামে ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচীসহ বিভিন্ন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করছে। নতুন কর্মএলাকা সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংস্থার কর্মএলাকায় গ্রামীণ জনগোষ্টির সাথে কাজ করতে আগ্রহী যোগ্য, সৎ, কর্মঠ ও অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন বাংলাদেশী নাগরিকদের নিকট থেকে জরুরী ভিত্তিতে "ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" পদে নিয়োগের জন্য আবেদনপত্র আহবান করা হচ্ছে।  
**পদের বিবরণ:** "ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত শাখায় সংস্থার পরিকল্পনা ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুসারে ঋণ ও আর্থিক সেবা কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা, বাস্তবায়ন তদারকি এবং লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন নিশ্চিত করবেন। পাশাপাশি শাখার লাভজনকতা বৃদ্ধি, কার্যক্রমের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখা, প্রশাসনিক ও কর্মী ব্যবস্থাপনা, আর্থিক ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং কর্মী প্রশিক্ষণেও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখবেন। এই পদে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত ব্যক্তি এরিয়া ম্যানেজার এবং জোনাল ম্যানেজারের নিকট রিপোর্টেবল থাকবেন।  
**কর্মস্থল:** সংস্থার কর্মএলাকা কিশোরগঞ্জ, গাজীপুর, নরসিংদী, নারায়নগঞ্জ, কুমিল্লা ও ঢাকা জেলার গ্রাম পর্যায়ে যেকোন শাখা অফিস।  
**চাকরির প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ:**

-   শাখা অফিসের সঠিক ব্যবস্থাপনা, দাপ্তরিক ও প্রশাসনিক কর্মকান্ড বাস্তবায়ন, কর্মী সুপারভিশন, মনিটরিং ও মূল্যায়ন সংক্রান্ত কাজ বাস্তবায়ন নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   শাখার লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনের জন্য মাসিক ও বার্ষিক কর্মপরিকল্পনা বা বাজেট তৈরিতে সহায়তা করা।
    
-   ঋণ আবেদন যাচাই বাছাই, ঋণ বিতরণ ও শতভাগ আদায়সহ কর্মী ব্যবস্থাপনা, সাপ্তাহিক, মাসিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও যাবতীয় হালনাগাদ তথ্য কম্পিউটারে প্রস্তুত নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   নতুন সমিতি গঠন ও সদস্য ভর্তি, ঋণী, প্রকল্প ও সঞ্চয় ফেরত ১০০% যাচাই নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   শাখার দৈনিক নগদ টাকার আদান-প্রদান (Cash Flow), যাবতীয় হিসাব-নিকাশ এবং আর্থিক বিষয়গুলো যাচাইসহ শাখার ভল্ট বা নগদ টাকার নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   সফটওয়ারের মাধ্যমে শাখার সকল প্রকার এমআইএস ও এআইএস নির্ভুল ভাবে যাচাই করে স্বাক্ষর নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   ঋণের অপব্যবহার বা কর্মীদের কোনো আর্থিক অনিয়ম হচ্ছে কি না, তা কঠোরভাবে নজরদারি করা এবং আর্থিক দুর্নীতি ও অনিয়ম প্রতিরোধে ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা।
    
-   অফিসের দৈনন্দিন হাজিরা, শৃঙ্খলা এবং কাজের সুষ্ঠু পরিবেশ নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   কর্মীদের কাজের ভুলত্রুটি সংশোধন করা এবং মাঠ পর্যায়ের সমস্যা সমাধানে সরাসরি দিকনির্দেশনা দেওয়া।
    
-   দৈনিক, সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক কাজের অগ্রগতি রিপোর্ট তৈরি করে আঞ্চলিক কার্যালয় বা প্রধান কার্যালয়ে পাঠানো।
    
-   স্থানীয় প্রশাসন, গণ্যমান্য ব্যক্তি এবং ব্যাংকের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
    
-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের অন্যান্য সামাজিক কর্মসূচি (যেমন: স্বাস্থ্যসেবা, শিক্ষা বা সচেতনতা বৃদ্ধি) মাঠ পর্যায়ে সফলভাবে বাস্তবায়ন করা।

আমরা জাতীয় দক্ষতা উন্নয়ন কর্তৃপক্ষ (NSDA)-এর অধীনে পরিচালিত প্রশিক্ষণ প্রকল্পের জন্য ১০ জন দক্ষ ও সার্টিফাইড ট্রেইনার (প্রশিক্ষক) নিয়োগ প্রদান করছি। নির্বাচিত ট্রেইনারদের নির্দিষ্ট কোর্স অনুযায়ী CBT&A (Competency-Based Training & Assessment) মেথডোলজিতে শিক্ষার্থীদের তত্ত্বীয় ও ব্যবহারিক প্রশিক্ষণ দিতে হবে।

A reputed and well-established **Buying House / Apparel Sourcing organization** is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to lead its overall Buying Services function. The selected candidate will be responsible for driving business growth, strengthening buyer relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and leading the end-to-end buying and sourcing activities.

-   Lead the overall **Buying Services, Sourcing and Merchandising operations** and ensure achievement of business, revenue, profitability, and operational targets.
    
-   Develop and implement effective sourcing and buying strategies aligned with international buyer requirements and organizational objectives.
    
-   Manage end-to-end activities covering **buyer development, product development, sourcing, merchandising, costing, order execution, quality, compliance, and shipment**.
    
-   Develop and maintain strong relationships with international buyers, brands, buying agents, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
    
-   Identify and develop new business opportunities and expand the organization\`s buyer and product portfolio.
    
-   Lead commercial negotiations with buyers and suppliers to ensure competitive pricing, healthy margins, quality, and timely delivery.
    
-   Oversee product development, sampling, costing, order placement, production follow-up, quality control, and shipment.
    
-   Ensure effective coordination among **Merchandising, Sourcing, Quality, Production, Commercial, Logistics, and Compliance** functions.
    
-   Build and maintain a strong supplier and factory network based on capability, quality, compliance, capacity, price, and delivery performance.
    
-   Monitor order execution and proactively resolve critical issues related to quality, delivery, costing, production, and customer requirements.
    
-   Ensure compliance with buyer-specific requirements, codes of conduct, social and environmental standards, and applicable laws and regulations.
    
-   Analyze market trends, customer expectations, product trends, and sourcing opportunities to support sustainable business growth.
    
-   Establish departmental KPIs and lead, mentor, and develop the Buying and Merchandising team.
    
-   Prepare business plans, budgets, forecasts, performance reports, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
    
-   Drive continuous improvement, cost optimization, process efficiency, and effective use of technology across the buying function.
    
-   Represent the organization in meetings, negotiations, and business discussions with buyers, brands, suppliers, and other key stakeholders.

title: এরিয়া ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)
description:
**জব কনটেক্সট:** পল্লী বিকাশ কেন্দ্র মাইক্রোক্রেডিট রেগুলেটরি অথরিটি কর্তৃক সনদপ্রাপ্ত (সনদ নং:-০০৫২৯-০৩৯৯৬-০০১৯০) এবং পিকেএসএফ, বিভিন্ন ব্যাংক, আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং নিজস্ব অর্থায়নে পরিচালিত একটি জাতীয় পর্যায়ের বেসরকারী উন্নয়ন সংস্থা। দরিদ্র জনগোষ্ঠির আর্থ-সামাজিক উন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে পল্লী বিকাশ কেন্দ্র দেশের বিভিন্ন জেলায় শহর ও গ্রামে ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচীসহ বিভিন্ন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করছে। নতুন কর্মএলাকা সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংস্থার কর্মএলাকায় গ্রামীণ জনগোষ্টির সাথে কাজ করতে আগ্রহী যোগ্য, সৎ, কর্মঠ ও অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন বাংলাদেশী নাগরিকদের নিকট থেকে জরুরী ভিত্তিতে "এরিয়া ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" পদে নিয়োগের জন্য আবেদনপত্র আহবান করা হচ্ছে।  
**পদের বিবরণ:** "এরিয়া ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত এরিয়া অধীনস্থ শাখাসমূহে সংস্থার পরিকল্পনা ও লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুসারে ঋণ ও আর্থিক সেবা কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা, বাস্তবায়ন তদারকি এবং লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন নিশ্চিত করবেন। পাশাপাশি শাখাসমূহের লাভজনকতা বৃদ্ধি, কার্যক্রমের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখা, প্রশাসনিক ও কর্মী ব্যবস্থাপনা, আর্থিক ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং কর্মী প্রশিক্ষণেও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখবেন। এই পদে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত ব্যক্তি জোনাল ম্যানেজার, সহকারী পরিচালক এবং মাইক্রোফিন্যান্স বিভাগীয় প্রধানের নিকট রিপোর্টেবল  
থাকবেন।  
**কর্মস্থল:** সংস্থার যেকোন শাখা অফিস।  
**চাকরির প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ:**

-   বিজনেস প্লান অনুযায়ী অধীনস্থ প্রতিটি শাখার জন্য বার্ষিক ও মাসিক লক্ষ্যমাত্রা (সদস্য সংখ্যা বৃদ্ধি, ঋণ বিতরণ ও আদায়) নির্ধারণ করে দেওয়া এবং নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে প্রতিটি শাখার লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জিত হচ্ছে কি না, তা নিয়মিত তদারকি করা।
    
-   প্রতিটি শাখার বকেয়া ঋণের (Overdue) হার নিয়ন্ত্রণে রাখা এবং খেলাপি ঋণ আদায়ে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপককে কৌশলগত পরামর্শ দেওয়া।
    
-   নিয়মিত বিভিন্ন সমিতি বা কেন্দ্র পরিদর্শন করে মাঠ কর্মীদের কাজের স্বচ্ছতা এবং ঋণের সঠিক ব্যবহার যাচাই করা।
    
-   এরিয়া ম্যানেজারের অনুমোদন সীমার ঋণের আবেদনগুলো যাচাই করে অনুমোদনের সুপারিশ করা।
    
-   শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক ও কর্মীদের কাজের মূল্যায়ন করা এবং তাদের পেশাদারিত্ব নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   কর্মীদের মধ্যে কাজের সুষম বণ্টন এবং প্রয়োজনে এক শাখা থেকে অন্য শাখায় কর্মী বদলির সুপারিশ করা।
    
-   শাখা পর্যায়ের যেকোনো অভ্যন্তরীণ দ্বন্দু বা শৃঙ্খলাজনিত সমস্যা সমাধান করা।
    
-   প্রতিটি শাখার ক্যাশ ও ব্যাংকের লেনদেন নিয়মিত পরীক্ষা করা যাতে কোনো আর্থিক অনিয়ম না ঘটে।
    
-   অভ্যন্তরীণ অডিট দলের পর্যবেক্ষণ অনুযায়ী ত্রুটিগুলো সংশোধনের ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া।
    
-   প্রতিটি শাখার অপারেশনাল খরচ (General Expenses) বাজেটের মধ্যে রাখা নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   প্রতিটি শাখার অগ্রগতির রিপোর্ট সংগ্রহ করে তা সমন্বিত আকারে ঊর্ধ্বতন কতৃপক্ষকে পাঠানো।
    
-   ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের সিদ্ধান্তগুলো মাঠ পর্যায়ে বাস্তবায়ন করা।
    
-   শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক ও মাঠ কর্মীদের দক্ষতার উন্নয়নে হাতে-কলমে ছোটখাটো প্রশিক্ষণের ব্যবস্থা করা।
    
-   স্থানীয় প্রশাসন, গণ্যমান্য ব্যক্তি এবং ব্যাংকের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
    
-   প্রতিষ্ঠানের অন্যান্য সামাজিক কর্মসূচি (যেমন: স্বাস্থ্যসেবা, শিক্ষা বা সচেতনতা বৃদ্ধি) মাঠ পর্যায়ে সফলভাবে বাস্তবায়ন করা।

title: ব্যাটারী সেকশন স্টাফ (সিলিং, ফিলিং, ফরমেশন ও অ্যাসেম্বলি)
description:
-   ব্যাটারী সিলিং,ফরমেশন ও অ্যাসেম্বলি সেকশনে দৈনন্দিন উৎপাদন কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করা।
    
-   বার্নিং ম্যানের কাজ করা।
    
-   সিলিং অপারেটরের দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
    
-   মেশিন ও টুলস সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহার ও রক্ষনাবেক্ষন করা।
    
-   কোয়ালিটি কন্ট্রোল টিমের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী কাজ করা।
    
-   প্রোডাকশন টার্গেট ও সেফটি রুলস মেনে চলা।
    
-   টিমওয়ার্ক ও পরিষ্কার পরিচ্ছন্ন কর্মপরিবেশ বজায় রাখা।

title: Staff Training & Technology Executive - Human Resource and Admin
description:
-   Recruitment advertisement, CV screening, interview, joining, appointment documents ও personnel file সমন্বয় করা।
-   Attendance, leave, probation, performance, payroll input, transfer, exit, employee access এবং office asset, ID/seal, vendor, safety ও visitor record হালনাগাদ করা।
-   Induction, SOP, ethics, anti-fraud, confidentiality, data security ও role training দেওয়া; presentation, practical exercise, test, coaching ও training register রাখা।
-   HRM, CRM, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, digital form, task tracker, dashboard, cloud storage ও online meeting tools ব্যবহার এবং কর্মীদের শেখানো।
-   বাংলাদেশ শ্রম আইন, শ্রম বিধিমালা, বৈদেশিক কর্মসংস্থান-সংক্রান্ত আইন, সরকারি নির্দেশনা ও company policy-এর প্রাসঙ্গিক পরিবর্তন official source থেকে পর্যবেক্ষণ করে Legal Update Register এবং management note প্রস্তুত করা।
-   Employee grievance গোপনীয়ভাবে গ্রহণ ও evidence সংরক্ষণ; harassment, fraud, bribery, retaliation, data breach বা licence risk তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে escalate করা।
-   Weekly HR/training dashboard এবং monthly headcount, attendance, training, movement, legal update ও exception report management-কে দেওয়া।

title: Area Manager (Pharmaceutical)
description:
The Company is looking for smart, self-motivated, hardworking and enthusiastic individuals who can successfully lead a group of MIOs to perform their best to achieve their target.

**Responsibilities:**

-   Achieve the team target of prescription and value sales.
    
-   Monitor and assist Sr./MIOs in achieving their individual targets.
    
-   Coaching and mentoring team members in achieving objectives.
    
-   Resolve any issues raised by the team members in consultation with Supervisor.
    
-   Prepare, update and submit reports using appropriate means.

title: জোনাল ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)
description:
**জব কনটেক্সট:** পল্লী বিকাশ কেন্দ্র মাইক্রোক্রেডিট রেগুলেটরি অথরিটি কর্তৃক সনদপ্রাপ্ত (সনদ নং:-০০৫২৯-০৩৯৯৬-০০১৯০) এবং পিকেএসএফ, বিভিন্ন ব্যাংক, আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং নিজস্ব অর্থায়নে পরিচালিত একটি জাতীয় পর্যায়ের বেসরকারী উন্নয়ন সংস্থা। দরিদ্র জনগোষ্ঠির আর্থ-সামাজিক উন্নয়নের লক্ষ্যে পল্লী বিকাশ কেন্দ্র দেশের বিভিন্ন জেলায় শহর ও গ্রামে ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচীসহ বিভিন্ন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করছে। নতুন কর্মএলাকা সম্প্রসারণের জন্য সংস্থার কর্মএলাকায় গ্রামীণ জনগোষ্টির সাথে কাজ করতে আগ্রহী যোগ্য, সৎ, কর্মঠ ও অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন বাংলাদেশী নাগরিকদের নিকট থেকে জরুরী ভিত্তিতে "জোনাল ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" পদে নিয়োগের জন্য আবেদনপত্র আহবান করা হচ্ছে।  
**পদের বিবরণ:** "জোনাল ম্যানেজার (ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কর্মসূচী)" দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত জোনের অন্তর্গত এরিয়া ও শাখাসমূহে সংস্থার ঋণ ও আর্থিক সেবা কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন তদারকি এবং লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন নিশ্চিত করবেন। পাশাপাশি কার্যক্রম সম্প্রসারণের কৌশল নির্ধারণ, নতুন নতুন সেবা খাত উদ্ভাবন, প্রান্তিক জনগোষ্ঠীর জন্য সেবা প্রদান নিশ্চিত এবং প্রোগ্রামের টেকসই উন্নয়ন নিশ্চিত করতে সার্বিক সহযোগিতা করবেন। এই পদে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত ব্যক্তি সহকারী পরিচালক এবং বিভাগীয় প্রধান (মাইক্রোফিন্যান্স প্রোগ্রাম)-এর নিকট রিপোর্টেবল থাকবেন  
**কর্মস্থল:** সংস্থার যেকোন জোন অফিস।  
**চাকরির প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ:**

-   দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত জোনের শাখাসমূহে সংস্থার পলিসি, এমআরএ, পিকেএসএফ, ব্যাংক ও সংশ্লিষ্ট আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠানের গাইডলাইন অনুযায়ী সংস্থার ক্ষুদ্রঋণ কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   জোনের বার্ষিক ও মাসিক বাজেট প্রণয়ন, আমানত সংগ্রহ, সদস্য বৃদ্ধি এবং ঋণ বিতরণের কৌশল নির্ধারণ এবং লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন নিশ্চিত করা।
    
-   গুণগত মান বজায় রেখে লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অনুসারে ঋণ বিতরণ ও শতভাগ আদায় নিশ্চিতের প্রয়োজনীয় পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণ করা।
    
-   শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক এবং এরিয়া ব্যবস্থাপকদের কাজের তদারকি এবং সমন্বয় করা।
    
-   নিয়মিত ও আকস্মিক শাখা পরিদর্শনের মাধ্যমে ক্যাশ বই, লেজার এবং অন্যান্য নথিপত্র যাচাই করা।
    
-   বকেয়া নিয়ন্ত্রণ এবং বকেয়া আদায়ের লক্ষ্যে পরিকল্পনা গ্রহণ এবং সরাসরি মাঠ পর্যায়ে গিয়ে বাস্তবায়ন তদারকি করা।
    
-   এরিয়া ম্যানেজার ও শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকদের নিয়ে নিয়মিত মাসিক পর্যালোচনা সভা (Monthly Review Meeting) করা।

title: Senior Fashion Designer & Product Development Manager (Woven Apparel)
description:
Reporting To: Director

Job Summary

Padma Satel Arab Fashion Ltd. is seeking an experienced and creative Senior Fashion Designer & Product Development Manager (Woven Apparel) to lead the design and product development process for international apparel markets. The ideal candidate will be responsible for researching global fashion trends, developing innovative woven collections, managing product development from concept to production, and collaborating closely with merchandising, sourcing, and production teams to deliver commercially successful products.

**Key Responsibilities**

-   Research international fashion brands including Zara, H&M, Mango, Next, Primark, Reserved, Sinsay, SMYK, Max, Babyshop, Carrefour, and Walmart to identify current market trends and customer preferences.
    
-   Analyze best-selling products, new silhouettes, fashion details, trims, colors, prints, and seasonal collections.
    
-   Study international retail pricing strategies and recommend competitive product positioning.
    
-   Monitor global fashion trends, forecasting reports, and consumer buying behavior to develop commercially viable collections.
    
-   Identify and recommend innovative fabrics, sustainable materials, washes, finishes, and garment constructions.
    
-   Develop seasonal woven apparel collections based on market demand and buyer requirements.
    
-   Prepare mood boards, trend boards, color palettes, fabric boards, and design presentations.
    
-   Create detailed technical sketches, artwork, specification sheets, and development packages for sample production.
    
-   Coordinate with merchandising, sourcing, and sample, pattern, and production teams throughout the product development process.
    
-   Source new fabrics, trims, accessories, and sustainable materials from local and international suppliers.
    
-   Ensure products meet buyer quality standards, costing targets, and delivery timelines.
    
-   Work closely with buyers during product presentations, development meetings, and sample approvals.
    
-   Review prototype samples, fitting comments, and production samples to ensure design accuracy.
    
-   Maintain awareness of sustainability trends, recycled materials, eco-friendly fabrics, and responsible manufacturing practices.
    
-   Collaborate with the merchandising team to optimize product cost while maintaining design integrity.
    
-   Drive continuous innovation by introducing new design concepts, value-added techniques, and fashion-forward developments.
    
-   Maintain product development calendars and ensure timely completion of all development milestones.
    
-   Support business growth by identifying new product opportunities and emerging fashion categories.

title: Script Writer
description:
# **Job Circular – Bangla News Script writer & Presenter (Male & Female)**

**Dhaka Editorial**

Dhaka Editorial is looking for **2 talented Bangla News Script Writers & Presenters (1 Male & 1 Female)** to join our editorial team. If you have a confident on-camera presence, clear Bangla pronunciation, and an interest in politics, current affairs, and digital journalism, we’d love to hear from you.

## **Position**

-   Bangla News Presenter (1 Male & 1 Female)
    

## **Key Responsibilities**

-   Script & Present Bangla news, political analysis, and current affairs content for YouTube and digital platforms.
    
-   Deliver scripts with confidence, clarity, and professionalism.
    
-   Record news bulletins, explainers, and special reports in our in-house studio.
    
-   Collaborate with scriptwriters, producers, and editors to ensure high-quality productions.
    
-   Maintain accuracy, neutrality, and a professional on-screen presence.
    
-   Be available to cover breaking news when required.
    

## **Requirements**

-   Excellent written and spoken Bangla with clear pronunciation and articulation.
    
-   Strong camera presence and confident presentation skills.
    
-   Interest in Bangladesh politics, international affairs, and current events.
    
-   Previous experience in news presenting, television, radio, or digital media is preferred but not mandatory.
    
-   Ability to memorize or read from a teleprompter naturally.
    
-   Punctual, professional, and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
    

## **Employment Type**

-   **Part-Time**
    

## **Work Schedule**

-   **3–4 days per week**
    
-   **4–5 hours per shooting day**
    
-   Work will be conducted from our **office studio**.
    

## **Salary**

-   **12,000-20,000 BDT (same range for both Male & Female candidates), based on experience and performance.**
    

## **Workplace**

-   Office Studio (Dhaka)
    

## **How to Apply**

Please send:

-   Your CV to **jonopath.bangla@gmail.com**
    
-   A **1–2 minute video introducing yourself in Bangla** or a sample news presentation (preferred) or any link of previous work.
    

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an audition.

description:
Position: Accounts Assistant (Remote – Bangladesh Based)

Reports To: Principal Accountant (CPA) & Registered Tax Agent (Australia)

Employment Type: Contractual

Location: Remote – Based in Bangladesh

Role Purpose

This remote role supports an Australian CPA and Registered Tax Agent by assisting with financial reporting, tax compliance, client administration, research-based documentation, and light marketing support. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working independently while collaborating across time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Tax & Compliance Support

• Assist in preparing individual, business, and trust tax returns under Australian tax law

• Support BAS, PAYG, GST, and other ATO reporting obligations

• Maintain accurate records for compliance and audit readiness

Financial Reporting

• Compile financial data for individuals, sole traders, partnerships, and companies

• Prepare draft financial statements, including balance sheets and profit & loss reports

-   Provide field insights and customer feedback to the sales and management teams.

-   Track delivery KPIs, team performance, and service quality metrics. 
    
-   Report operational challenges and recommend process improvements. 
    
-   Maintain accurate records of delivery personnel and area performance. 
    

Work Structure 

-   **50% Field Work** – Visiting pharmacies and managing delivery operations in assigned zones. 
    
-   **50% Office Work** – Reporting, planning, coordination, recruitment, and performance monitoring. 
    

Work Location 

Adabor, Mohammadpur, Dhaka (Field visits across Mirpur, Jatrabari, Badda, Uttara, and Dhanmondi zones as required).

title: Student Counselor (Study Abroad)
description:

title: BOQ Cost Estimation Analyst, Interior & Construction
description:
Floor Planner Limited is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented **BOQ Cost Estimation Analyst** with practical experience in interior construction, quantity take-off, cost estimation, billing, and project coordination.

The selected candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate Bills of Quantities, conducting rate analysis, reviewing project measurements, checking contractor bills, and coordinating with architects, engineers, consultants, vendors, and project-management teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

-   Prepare preliminary cost estimates and initial Bills of Quantities based on drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
    
-   Develop and maintain project-specific BOQ formats in Microsoft Excel.
    
-   Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity take-offs, rate analyses, and project budgets.
    
-   Calculate quantities for civil, architectural, interior, electrical, plumbing, and finishing works.
    
-   Prepare item descriptions, technical specifications, unit rates, and detailed cost breakdowns.
    
-   Develop competitive and strategic bids with detailed material, labour, equipment, overhead, and project-cost analyses.
    
-   Maintain updated material and labour-rate databases through regular market surveys and supplier quotations.
    
-   Review architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing, interior, and other relevant drawings before preparing the BOQ.
    
-   Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, electrical engineers, plumbing engineers, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and project teams.
    
-   Collect approved 2D drawings, 3D designs, floor layouts, working drawings, specifications, and other required documents from the relevant departments.
    
-   Identify discrepancies, missing information, and coordination issues in drawings and communicate them to the concerned teams.
    
-   Prepare and modify working drawings in AutoCAD when required.
    
-   Prepare tender BOQs, revised BOQs, variation orders, comparative statements, and final BOQs.
    
-   Conduct value engineering to achieve cost efficiency without compromising quality, functionality, or design intent.
    
-   Prepare and maintain material sample lists, sample boards, and material approval records.
    
-   Review and verify construction and interior-work bills against the approved BOQ, drawings, specifications, site measurements, and Measurement Book.
    
-   Collect, check, and maintain Measurement Books for running and final billing purposes.
    
-   Prepare interim payment certificates, running bills, subcontractor bills, and final bills using documents provided by the project-management and site teams.
    
-   Conduct site visits when required to verify quantities, measurements, work progress, variations, and completed works.
    
-   Prepare BOQ revisions, cost comparisons, project-cost reports, and final cost reconciliation statements.
    
-   Monitor budget versus actual expenditure and report significant cost variances.
    
-   Maintain proper documentation of estimates, quotations, approvals, measurements, variations, bills, and reconciliation records.
    
-   Perform any other duties assigned by the management.

title: Pattern Master
description:

-   Maintain quality standards and ensure patterns comply with buyer/brand specifications.
-   Perform other duties as assigned by management.

title: RMO Cum Sonologist (Female)

company.name: Safiul Alam Hatiya Adhunik Hospital & Diagnostic Center

description:
**Job Highlights**

**Main Purpose:** Provide safe, effective, and evidence-based medical care in the OPD, IPD, and Emergency Department while delivering high-quality diagnostic ultrasonography services according to updated clinical knowledge, national guidelines, and hospital quality standards.

**Position Summary:**

The **RMO Cum Sonologist** is responsible for providing comprehensive medical care to patients in the Emergency Department, Outpatient Department (OPD), and Inpatient Wards while independently performing high-quality diagnostic ultrasonography examinations and reporting. The role requires clinical decision-making, emergency management, patient monitoring, diagnostic imaging, and close coordination with consultants to ensure safe, ethical, and evidence-based patient care.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Emergency & Patient Management**

-   Perform primary assessment, diagnosis, and stabilization of patients presenting to the Emergency Department.
    
-   Provide immediate emergency management and basic life-saving interventions for critically ill patients.
    
-   Admit, observe, or refer patients based on clinical findings and consultant recommendations.
    
-   Manage medical emergencies according to national treatment guidelines and hospital protocols.
    

**OPD & Inpatient Care**

-   Provide consultation to OPD patients and ensure appropriate treatment and follow-up.
    
-   Conduct daily ward rounds and monitor admitted patients in coordination with consultants.
    
-   Prepare admission notes, progress notes, referral notes, and discharge summaries.
    
-   Ensure continuity of medical care during duty hours.
    

**Diagnostic Ultrasonography Services**

-   Perform routine and emergency ultrasonography examinations independently.
    
-   Conduct abdominal, pelvic, obstetric, gynaecological, breast, thyroid, scrotal, soft tissue, musculoskeletal, vascular, and small parts ultrasound examinations.
    
-   Perform Colour Doppler studies where indicated.
    
-   Ensure high-quality image acquisition and accurate documentation.
    

**Obstetric & Gynaecological Imaging**

-   Perform first, second, and third trimester obstetric ultrasound examinations.
    
-   Assess fetal growth, fetal biometry, fetal wellbeing, placental localisation, liquor volume, and fetal presentation.
    
-   Detect congenital anomalies and identify high-risk pregnancy findings.
    
-   Perform transabdominal and transvaginal ultrasound examinations where appropriate.
    

**Reporting & Clinical Support**

-   Interpret ultrasound findings and prepare accurate diagnostic reports.
    
-   Immediately communicate urgent or critical findings to the treating consultant.
    
-   Request and review laboratory and imaging investigations relevant to patient management.
    
-   Prescribe medications according to consultant advice and national clinical protocols.
    

**Clinical Procedures**

-   Perform routine bedside procedures including wound care, suturing, catheterization, nasogastric tube insertion, oxygen therapy, and basic airway management.
    
-   Provide Basic Life Support (BLS) during emergency situations.
    

**Patient Communication**

-   Explain diagnoses, ultrasound findings, treatment plans, and prognosis clearly and compassionately.
    
-   Maintain patient confidentiality, informed consent, and professional ethics.
    
-   Ensure patient comfort throughout medical consultations and ultrasound examinations.
    

**Coordination & Teamwork**

-   Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, laboratory, pharmacy, radiology, and hospital administration.
    
-   Participate in clinical meetings, mortality reviews, audits, and Continuing Medical Education (CME) activities.
    

**Infection Prevention & Quality Assurance**

-   Follow Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) protocols during all clinical and ultrasound procedures.
    
-   Ensure proper maintenance and safe operation of ultrasound equipment.
    
-   Maintain complete and accurate medical records, ultrasound reports, and hospital documentation.

title: Medical Officer (Female)

company.name: Safiul Alam Hatiya Adhunik Hospital & Diagnostic Center

description:
**Job Highlights**

**Main Purpose:** Provide safe and effective OPD, IPD and Emergency medical care to patients according to updated clinical knowledge, national protocols, and standard hygiene practices, ensuring high-quality patient management health outcomes.

**Position Summary:**

Medical Officer (MO) / Duty Doctor is responsible for providing continuous medical care to patients in the Emergency Department, Outpatient Department (OPD), and Inpatient Wards. The role involves patient assessment, emergency management, clinical supervision, coordination with consultants, and ensuring high standards of patient care, safety, and documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Emergency & Patient Management:**

-   Perform primary assessment, diagnosis, and stabilization of patients presenting to the Emergency/Casualty Department.
    
-   Provide immediate life-saving care and resuscitation in critical conditions such as cardiac arrest, trauma, respiratory distress, and shock.
    
-   Admit, observe, or refer patients based on clinical evaluation.
    

**Ward & Inpatient Care:**

-   Conduct daily ward rounds, monitor patient progress, and update treatment plans in coordination with consultants.
    
-   Ensure continuous 24/7 medical coverage for admitted patients.
    
-   Prepare admission notes, progress notes, and discharge summaries.
    

**Clinical Procedures:**

-   Perform emergency and routine clinical procedures including:
    
-   Suturing and wound care, Catheterization and NG tube insertion
    
-   Basic airway management and oxygen therapy
    
-   Basic resuscitation following BLS/ACLS principles
    

**Diagnostics & Treatment:**

-   Prescribe medications and initiate treatment according to consultant advice and National protocols.
    
-   Arrange and review laboratory tests, imaging, and other diagnostic investigations.
    
-   Ensure rational use of medicines, especially antibiotics.
    

**Patient Communication:**

-   Explain diagnosis, treatment plans, and prognosis to patients and families in a clear and compassionate manner.
    
-   Maintain patient confidentiality and ethical medical practice.
    

**Coordination & Teamwork:**

-   Coordinate with consultants, nurses, laboratory, pharmacy, and hospital administration for smooth patient management.
    
-   Participate in clinical meetings, audits, and training activities.
    

**Infection Control & Quality Assurance:**

-   Follow infection prevention and control (IPC) protocols and ensure safe use of medical equipment and Maintain proper documentation and hospital records.
